note: Per-film readings. Predicaments are free text on purpose — the vocabulary is mined from them afterwards, not imposed before. `relatives` is NOT an edge list: see the header of readings.js.

films.title: Rashomon
films.engine: Four people who were present when a woman was raped and her husband died each give a sworn account in which they behaved honourably, and three men sheltering from the rain try to work out whether anyone can be believed about anything. Underneath the puzzle is a plainer test: whether a man who has lied to save himself is still capable of a decent act.

predicaments.situation: everyone tells the version that saves their face
predicaments.basis: The bandit Tajōmaru claims an honourable duel, the wife claims she fainted with the dagger in her hand, the dead samurai speaking through a medium claims suicide, and the woodcutter claims he only found the body.

roles.tellers: Tajōmaru, the wife, the samurai, the woodcutter
roles.hearers: the monk and the commoner at the gate

predicaments.situation: a witness hides what he saw
predicaments.basis: The woodcutter testified that he merely discovered the corpse, and only under pressure admits he watched the whole killing — and, the commoner deduces, stole the wife's dagger from the scene.

predicaments.situation: the injured party is blamed for the injury
predicaments.basis: In every account the wife is treated as spoiled goods after the rape — her husband stares at her with loathing and refuses to risk his life for a ruined woman.

predicaments.situation: someone abandoned is taken in by strangers
predicaments.basis: A baby is left at the gate with a kimono and an amulet, and the woodcutter says he will raise it alongside his own children.

predicaments.situation: one man's decency restores another's faith in people
predicaments.basis: The monk, sickened by the testimony and by the commoner stripping the baby, first recoils from the woodcutter and then hands him the child.

relatives.title: The Last Duel
relatives.shares: one assault told three times, each version arranged so its teller comes out honourable

relatives.title: Anatomy of a Fall
relatives.shares: a death reconstructed from accounts that cannot all be true, with no arbiter left

relatives.title: Hero
relatives.shares: successive retellings of the same encounter, each shaped by what the teller needs believed

relatives.title: The Usual Suspects
relatives.shares: a self-serving witness whose account is the only version anyone has

relatives.title: The Kid
relatives.shares: an abandoned infant taken up by a poor man who decides to raise it

films.title: Seven Samurai
films.engine: Farmers with nothing to pay but food hire warriors to stand between them and the bandits who will come at harvest, and both sides have to live with what the bargain exposes: the villagers have been murdering wounded warriors for their armour, and one of the men they hired was born a farmer himself. The village survives; the men who saved it are mostly buried above it, and the ones left are not wanted there.

predicaments.situation: the weak hire the strong to protect them
predicaments.basis: On the elder Gisaku's advice the villagers go to town to find hungry rōnin who will fight for rice, and Kambei accepts after seeing their suffering.

predicaments.situation: the victims turn out to be predators too
predicaments.basis: Kikuchiyo brings out armour and spears the villagers stripped from wounded and fleeing samurai, and the hired men's fury turns to shame when he says so.

predicaments.situation: a man hides the people he came from
predicaments.basis: Kikuchiyo has claimed to be a samurai on forged papers and blurts out, defending the villagers' scavenging, that he was born a farmer.

predicaments.situation: birth forbids two people to each other
predicaments.basis: Katsushirō and Shino, a farmer's daughter her father disguised as a boy, share rice and a hut knowing their difference in class rules it out; her father beats her when he finds out.

predicaments.situation: someone taken away refuses to be reclaimed
predicaments.basis: Rikichi's wife, carried off in an earlier raid, sees her husband across the burning bandit camp and walks back into the fire.

predicaments.situation: the rescued outlive the ones who saved them
predicaments.basis: Four of the seven lie under grave mounds while the villagers plant and sing, Shino walks past Katsushirō, and Kambei says the farmers are the ones who won.

relatives.title: Sholay
relatives.shares: a village that cannot fight buys the services of men who can, and pays for it in their deaths

relatives.title: Shane
relatives.shares: the fighter who secures the settlers' ground cannot then live on it

relatives.title: The Magnificent Seven
relatives.shares: farmers hire outnumbered gunmen for food and a share of the harvest

relatives.title: A Bug's Life
relatives.shares: the harvested weak recruit outsiders to face the raiders who come every season

relatives.title: Rome, Open City
relatives.shares: protectors and protected discovering what each has done to survive the other's absence

films.title: Once Upon a Time in the West
films.engine: A former prostitute arrives at a desert farm to find the husband and stepchildren she came to join shot dead, and inherits the one patch of ground the coming railroad must buy. While a dying track-layer and the killer he hired manoeuvre for it, a stranger with a harmonica waits out the whole business for a private reason: as a boy this killer stood him under his own brother's noose and left him to hold the weight.

predicaments.situation: a man spends his life hunting one man
predicaments.basis: Harmonica trails Frank across the territory, even saving him from Morton's bribed assassins so that nobody else takes him, and Frank cannot work out why.

predicaments.situation: a child is made part of a killing
predicaments.basis: In flashback Frank props a boy under his hanging brother's feet and pushes a harmonica in his mouth until the boy's legs give out.

predicaments.situation: a family is killed to clear a path
predicaments.basis: Frank's gang guns down Brett McBain and his three children at Sweetwater and leaves a duster to pin it on Cheyenne, because the ranch sits where the water stop must go.

predicaments.situation: a widow inherits what several men want
predicaments.basis: Jill, married to McBain a month earlier in New Orleans, becomes the owner of Sweetwater and is forced to auction it after Frank corners her.

predicaments.situation: a man hired to frighten kills instead
predicaments.basis: Morton paid Frank to intimidate McBain off the land; Frank massacres the family and starts angling to own Sweetwater himself, so Morton buys Frank's own men to shoot him.

predicaments.situation: the rescued outlive the ones who saved them
predicaments.basis: Cheyenne dies of his wound on the road and Harmonica rides off with the body while Jill carries water out to the men laying track.

relatives.title: Oldboy
relatives.shares: a man's entire adult life organised around an injury done in childhood, unrecognised by the one who did it

relatives.title: Kill Bill
relatives.shares: a survivor of a killing who waits years to stand in front of the person responsible

relatives.title: The Bride Wore Black
relatives.shares: a patient hunter working through the men who destroyed a life, unknown to them

relatives.title: There Will Be Blood
relatives.shares: land bought and cleared by violence because of what will have to pass through it

relatives.title: Chinatown
relatives.shares: a widow left holding property whose real value is the water under it

films.title: La Jetée
films.engine: Survivors of a war live underground and send a prisoner back through time because one image from his childhood — a woman's face on an airport platform, and a man dying in front of him — grips him hard enough that he survives the trip. He finds the woman, is offered a permanent escape to the future, asks instead to be returned to her, and learns on that platform that the death he watched as a boy was his own.

predicaments.situation: a person is discarded once no longer useful
predicaments.basis: Having brought back a power unit that can restart his society, the prisoner realises his jailers now intend to execute him.

predicaments.situation: a man returns to the woman he remembers
predicaments.basis: On repeated passages into the pre-war years he finds the woman from the airport memory and they become lovers.

predicaments.situation: a man refuses rescue to return to someone
predicaments.basis: The people of the future offer to take him into their era permanently; he asks instead to be sent back to the pre-war airport to look for her.

predicaments.situation: a man is present at his own death
predicaments.basis: Running toward her on the jetty he sees an agent of his jailers and understands that the man he saw die there as a child was himself.

relatives.title: Vertigo
relatives.shares: a man organising his life around recovering a woman fixed in a single remembered image

relatives.title: Solaris
relatives.shares: a man given back a woman who exists because his memory kept her

relatives.title: Arrival
relatives.shares: someone who chooses the person knowing exactly how it ends

relatives.title: 12 Monkeys
relatives.shares: a prisoner sent back by the survivors of a plague, closing a death he witnessed as a child

relatives.title: Oedipus Rex
relatives.shares: the effort to escape a foreseen death being the thing that delivers it

films.title: Taxi Driver
films.engine: A sleepless veteran driving nights in New York tries twice to attach himself to another person — a campaign worker he courts and loses in one wrong choice of evening, and a twelve-year-old he decides to take out of a brothel — and cannot make anyone, including a fellow driver he half-confesses to, hear what is wrong with him. The unheard part arms itself, goes looking for someone worth killing, and the city reads the result as heroism.

predicaments.situation: a man cannot make anyone hear his distress
predicaments.basis: Travis tells Wizard about his violent thoughts and is told he'll be fine; his diary is the only place his state gets recorded.

predicaments.situation: a suitor ruins his chance in one evening
predicaments.basis: Betsy accepts coffee and a second date, and Travis takes her to an adult movie theatre; she walks out, refuses to be reconciled, and he storms her campaign office to berate her.

predicaments.situation: private rage looks for a public target
predicaments.basis: Travis buys four handguns, trains, writes a threatening letter to Senator Palantine and shaves a mohawk before Secret Service agents at the rally force him to run.

predicaments.situation: a stranger decides to rescue a child
predicaments.basis: Travis pays Sport for time with twelve-year-old Iris only to argue her out of the life, then returns and shoots his way through the brothel.

predicaments.situation: a killer is received as a hero
predicaments.basis: Travis kills three men, is not prosecuted, is written up in the papers as a vigilante who saved a girl, and gets a thank-you letter from Iris's parents.

relatives.title: The Searchers
relatives.shares: a solitary violent man appointing himself the rescuer of a girl living among people he loathes

relatives.title: You Were Never Really Here
relatives.shares: a damaged veteran extracting a trafficked girl by force because talking has stopped working for him

relatives.title: Falling Down
relatives.shares: a man whose grievance with a city can no longer be spoken and arms itself instead

relatives.title: Pickpocket
relatives.shares: a solitary diarist narrating himself into an act he can't otherwise explain

relatives.title: Joker
relatives.shares: private derangement mistaken by a city for a public gesture on its behalf

films.title: La Strada
films.engine: A mother with too many children sells her simple-minded daughter to the travelling strongman who took her other daughter on the road and brought her back dead. The girl spends the road trying to be useful and loved by a man who can only take, and he understands what she was only years later, drunk on a beach, hearing her tune sung by someone else.

predicaments.situation: a family sells a daughter to a stranger
predicaments.basis: Zampanò returns a year after Rosa's death and pays Gelsomina's mother 10,000 lire to take her instead; the girl leaves the same day in tears.

predicaments.situation: someone loves the person who mistreats them
predicaments.basis: Gelsomina is beaten, forced on, presented as a wife she isn't and left in the street while he goes off with another woman, and she still offers to marry him.

predicaments.situation: a weaker man taunts a stronger one
predicaments.basis: Il Matto needles Zampanò at every chance and cannot say why, and when they meet again on an empty road the strongman's punches kill him.

predicaments.situation: a person is discarded once no longer useful
predicaments.basis: After the killing breaks her mind and she can no longer perform, Zampanò leaves Gelsomina asleep by the road with some clothes, money and his trumpet.

predicaments.situation: someone abandoned is taken in by strangers
predicaments.basis: A man found Gelsomina on the beach and his family kept her; she barely spoke, played the same tune, and one day did not wake up.

predicaments.situation: someone matters only once they are gone
predicaments.basis: Years on, Zampanò hears a woman singing Gelsomina's melody, learns she is dead, fights in a bar and collapses weeping on the sand.

relatives.title: Sansho the Bailiff
relatives.shares: a child handed over to a man who owns her labour, and the family that never gets her back

relatives.title: Mouchette
relatives.shares: a girl with no one, worn down by the men who happen to have use for her

relatives.title: Vagabond
relatives.shares: a wanderer taken in by strangers, left again, and understood only after her death

relatives.title: Nights of Cabiria
relatives.shares: a trusting soul giving everything to the man who has already decided to abandon her

relatives.title: The Wrestler
relatives.shares: a performer whose body is his only livelihood, discarding the person who cares for him

films.title: Blowup
films.engine: A photographer who spends his days pointing a camera at people he has no interest in knowing takes some idle shots of a couple in a park, and enlarging them finds what looks like a killing he unknowingly interrupted. From then on he tries to get one other person — the woman in the pictures, his agent, anyone — to look at what he has seen, and each time the proof and the audience both slip away. By the end he is left with nothing to show and joins a group miming a game with no ball.

predicaments.situation: a witness cannot make anyone believe them
predicaments.basis: Thomas telephones Ron claiming he may have saved a man's life, then begs him at the party to come to the park as a witness, and cannot get through to him.

predicaments.situation: someone removes the proof of what was done
predicaments.basis: His studio is ransacked and every negative and print taken except one grainy blow-up, and when he returns to the park the body under the bush is gone.

predicaments.situation: someone takes another's likeness without permission
predicaments.basis: Thomas furtively photographs the older man and the younger woman in Maryon Park and keeps shooting as Jane runs at him demanding the film.

predicaments.situation: someone agrees to play along with a pretence
predicaments.basis: At the end he picks up the mimes' imaginary tennis ball and throws it back, after which the sound of the ball being struck is heard.

relatives.title: The Conversation
relatives.shares: a man reworks his own recording of strangers until he cannot make anyone act on what he thinks he witnessed

relatives.title: Caché
relatives.shares: images of people taken without their knowledge arrive as evidence of something that is never confirmed

relatives.title: L'Avventura
relatives.shares: a disappearance that the people best placed to care about it quietly stop pursuing

relatives.title: Memories of Murder
relatives.shares: every piece of proof degrades until the man holding it is left with only his own conviction

relatives.title: Picnic at Hanging Rock
relatives.shares: a vanishing no search or account ever settles, leaving the searchers changed instead

films.title: Persona
films.engine: An actress stops speaking by choice and is sent to a seaside cottage with the young nurse assigned to her; the nurse, finding herself listened to for the first time in her life, empties out her secrets into the silence. Then she reads a letter showing that the silence was collecting her rather than receiving her, and the fury of that discovery starts dissolving the line between the two of them — the nurse ends up telling the actress's own life back to her and having to insist aloud that she is not her.

predicaments.situation: one person talks into another's silence
predicaments.basis: Elisabet has willed herself mute and Alma, alone with her at the cottage, says no one has ever really listened to her before, then recounts her fiancé, the beach orgy and the abortion.

predicaments.situation: a confidence is collected rather than received
predicaments.basis: Alma reads Elisabet's unsealed letter and finds her story of the orgy and the abortion written up as something Elisabet is "studying".

predicaments.situation: two people are no longer told apart
predicaments.basis: Elisabet's husband arrives and calls Alma by his wife's name, and Alma later narrates Elisabet's motherhood back to her before insisting on her own identity.

predicaments.situation: a parent cannot love the child they bore
predicaments.basis: Elisabet tears up the photograph of her son, and Alma tells the story of the failed self-induced abortion and the boy who craves the love of a mother who despises him.

predicaments.situation: someone agrees to play along with a pretence
predicaments.basis: Alma tells the husband he is mistaken about who she is and then sleeps with him anyway as Elisabet.

relatives.title: 3 Women
relatives.shares: two women isolated together, one absorbing the other's history until neither occupies her own life

relatives.title: Mulholland Drive
relatives.shares: a woman's account of herself turns out to belong to someone else, and the two identities will not stay separate

relatives.title: The Servant
relatives.shares: a household of two in which the one who tends becomes the one who possesses

relatives.title: Vertigo
relatives.shares: one person is remade into the likeness of another and cannot assert a self against it

relatives.title: Certified Copy
relatives.shares: two people slide into a relation neither of them actually holds and keep playing it

films.title: The Battle of Algiers
films.engine: In a colonial capital, the people of the old quarter build a secret network of cells that answers being ruled by killing Europeans at random, and the state answers by sending soldiers who take the network apart one man at a time, using pain on each captive to get the next name. Both sides do their worst to civilians and each treats the other's worst as its justification; the network is destroyed and the crowds come out anyway.

predicaments.situation: a people is ruled by outsiders it rejects
predicaments.basis: Algerians in the Casbah live under French administration alongside pieds-noirs, and the FLN organizes cells to end that rule between 1954 and 1957.

predicaments.situation: someone is pressed to betray their own side
predicaments.basis: Ali la Pointe's compatriot gives up his hideout after being tortured, and the paratroopers work up the FLN leadership by the same method.

predicaments.situation: each side answers the other's cruelty with worse
predicaments.basis: The FLN bombs European cafés while the security forces reply with indiscriminate killings, intimidation and routine torture.

predicaments.situation: a movement kills its own to keep order
predicaments.basis: The FLN takes control of the Casbah by summarily executing Algerian criminals and those suspected of collaborating with the French.

predicaments.situation: a crowd acts as one against its rulers
predicaments.basis: The film closes on mass nationalist demonstrations and riots, with the Algerian extras used as a chanting, wailing chorus.

predicaments.situation: a criminal is turned into a believer
predicaments.basis: Ali la Pointe, a petty criminal, is politically radicalized in prison and recruited by the FLN commander El-Hadi Jafar.

relatives.title: Army of Shadows
relatives.shares: a clandestine network under occupation that must kill its own people to survive interrogation

relatives.title: Rome, Open City
relatives.shares: an occupier extracting names by torture while the occupied city closes around its cells

relatives.title: The Wind That Shakes the Barley
relatives.shares: an insurgency and a counter-insurgency each licensing its atrocities with the other's

relatives.title: Zero Dark Thirty
relatives.shares: pain applied to captives as the machine that unpicks a clandestine organization

relatives.title: Battle of Chile
relatives.shares: a defeat on the ground that the crowd in the street refuses to accept as the end

films.title: Le Samouraï
films.engine: A hitman whose whole method is leaving no trace is seen plainly by a woman as he walks out of a killing, and though she declines to identify him to the police, the men who commissioned the job decide that a suspected man is a man to be deleted. Squeezed between police who bug his room and tail him through the city and clients who shoot at him instead of paying, he closes off his own exits one by one and finally walks into the club with an unloaded gun, points it at the woman, and lets the police fire.

predicaments.situation: the ones paying now want them gone
predicaments.basis: When Jef goes to collect his fee for killing Martey, the go-between shoots him in the arm rather than pay, because the police suspicion has made him a liability to Olivier Rey.

predicaments.situation: someone is pressed to betray their own side
predicaments.basis: The police search Jane's flat and offer to leave her alone if she withdraws Jef's alibi; she flatly refuses.

predicaments.situation: a stranger shields someone for reasons unknown
predicaments.basis: Valérie sees Jef leaving the murder scene, then fails to pick him out at the identity parade, and he goes to her home to find out who told her to stay silent.

predicaments.situation: a person is watched constantly by unseen others
predicaments.basis: Officers bug his single room while he is out — he detects it only from his bird's scattered feathers — and dozens of plainclothes police track him through the Métro.

predicaments.situation: someone walks knowingly into their own death
predicaments.basis: Jef returns to the club making no effort to be unseen, leaves his hat-check ticket, puts on his gloves in front of everyone and aims at Valérie with a gun the commissaire later finds to be unloaded.

relatives.title: Branded to Kill
relatives.shares: a contract killer becomes the next contract for the organization that employed him

relatives.title: The Killer
relatives.shares: a hitman and the woman who sees him form a wordless pact against both police and paymasters

relatives.title: This Gun for Hire
relatives.shares: a hired gun turns on the men who paid him off and marked him for disposal

relatives.title: Ghost Dog: The Way of the Samurai
relatives.shares: a solitary killer keeps a private code to the point of arranging his own execution

relatives.title: Drive
relatives.shares: a man of pure method is exposed by being seen, and closes his own escape routes to protect a woman

films.title: The White Ribbon
films.engine: In a northern village where a pastor, a doctor and a landowner hold every family through shame, wages or debt, the children raised on that discipline — hands tied at night, white ribbons for impurity, beatings for small thefts — grow into the likely source of a run of anonymous cruelties against the village's weakest. Nobody is ever named: the woman who says she knows disappears with her son, the doctor's household empties overnight, and the schoolteacher who says out loud what he suspects is threatened with jail and later drafted away.

predicaments.situation: children are punished into silence by their elders
predicaments.basis: The pastor extracts a confession of impure touching from his son and has his hands tied to the bed each night, makes his children wear white ribbons, and the steward thrashes his boy for a stolen flute.

predicaments.situation: an adult uses a child in their care
predicaments.basis: The doctor is kind to the village children in his surgery while sexually abusing his own teenage daughter and humiliating the midwife he sleeps with.

predicaments.situation: everyone's living depends on one household's favour
predicaments.basis: The baron employs most of the village as farm workers, pays for the harvest festivities, and dismisses Eva outright when his son is found beaten in the sawmill.

predicaments.situation: no one is ever named for the harm
predicaments.basis: The wire that unhorses the doctor, the caning of the baron's son, the barn fire, the impaled bird and the near-blinding of the midwife's handicapped son all go unattributed.

predicaments.situation: a witness cannot make anyone believe them
predicaments.basis: The schoolteacher confronts the pastor in the rectory with his suspicion that the confirmation children did these things, and is berated and threatened with jail if he repeats it.

predicaments.situation: someone removes the proof of what was done
predicaments.basis: The midwife takes the schoolteacher's bicycle to tell the police what her son said about his attacker and is never seen again, and the doctor's family vanishes leaving a note on the door.

relatives.title: Dogville
relatives.shares: a closed community whose ordinary order turns into organized cruelty that everyone tacitly consents to

relatives.title: The Innocents
relatives.shares: children whose enforced purity may be the cover for the harm being done, with no adult able to establish it

relatives.title: The Hunt
relatives.shares: a village where an accusation can neither be proved nor withdrawn and the accuser's neighbours choose the comfortable story

relatives.title: Fanny and Alexander
relatives.shares: a household run by a clergyman's discipline, where the children are corrected for their own salvation

relatives.title: Los Olvidados
relatives.shares: children formed by adult brutality who reproduce it exactly on those weaker than themselves

films.title: Street of Shame
films.engine: Five women sell sex in a licensed house in Tokyo while the legislature debates outlawing the trade, and each is working an exit — a debt paid off, a marriage, a family reclaimed, a son to be proud of. Each exit turns out to run through someone who wants them for money, labour or nothing at all: the client who embezzles for a promised elopement, the husband who marries for free help, the son who disowns his mother. The ban fails, one woman gets out by becoming a proprietor herself, and a new girl is put on the doorstep.

predicaments.situation: everyone's living depends on one household's favour
predicaments.basis: The Taya couple own Dreamland and hold the women's debts, so Yorie cannot leave to marry until a court voids what she owes them.

roles.held: Yasumi, Mickey, Hanae, Yorie and Yumeko

predicaments.situation: a promise of love conceals a transaction
predicaments.basis: Yasumi lets Mr. Aoki believe she will elope with him until he has embezzled to clear her debts, and the man Yorie leaves to marry turns out to have wanted cheap labour.

predicaments.situation: one person carries a whole family's debts
predicaments.basis: Yasumi works to bail her father out of jail for corruption, Hanae supports a suicidal husband and an infant until they are evicted, and Mickey's father comes from Kobe to ask her to quit for the family's sake.

predicaments.situation: a child turns away from a shamed parent
predicaments.basis: Yumeko's son, working in Tokyo, denounces her trade and disowns her, after which she loses her mind and is taken away; Mickey throws her father out for his hedonism during her mother's life.

predicaments.situation: a deceiver is nearly killed by the deceived
predicaments.basis: When Aoki grasps that Yasumi never intended to marry him, the confrontation becomes a struggle in which he almost kills her.

predicaments.situation: one person escapes what the others cannot
predicaments.basis: Yasumi recovers, buys the futon and fabric business next door — with the brothel as her first customer — while the young maid Shizuko is put out front to solicit.

relatives.title: Nights of Cabiria
relatives.shares: a woman's one plausible exit from the trade is a marriage that turns out to be a swindle

relatives.title: Mamma Roma
relatives.shares: a mother whose work is the thing her son cannot forgive her for

relatives.title: Vivre sa vie
relatives.shares: a woman's earnings, debts and protection all pass through the man who runs the house

relatives.title: Rosetta
relatives.shares: one person carrying a household alone, clawing at any legitimate foothold out

relatives.title: Sisters of the Gion
relatives.shares: women discovering that every route out of the trade is another transaction with a man

films.title: Memories of Murder
films.engine: Two policemen with opposite ideas of how a truth is arrived at — one who believes he can read guilt in a face, one who believes in evidence — are put on a run of killings in a town with neither the tools nor the patience for either method. Every time they need a culprit they manufacture one out of whoever is weakest, and when at last they settle on a man they believe in, nothing they have will hold him. The killer walks off into the ordinary population and the two men are left carrying what they did to get nowhere.

predicaments.situation: a wrong is never traced to anyone
predicaments.basis: the murders run for years, the semen sample sent abroad comes back inconclusive, and seventeen years later the case is still open and the man at the first scene is described only as looking like anybody.

predicaments.situation: a confession is beaten out of the powerless
predicaments.basis: Cho beats the scarred, mentally handicapped Baek Kwang-ho into confessing to killings he could not have committed, and the same treatment is later turned on the mine clerk Hyeon-gyu.

predicaments.situation: two men trust opposite ways of knowing
predicaments.basis: Park claims to identify suspects by eye contact while Seo, sent from Seoul, reads crime reports, weather and clothing colour; they fight, then need each other, and at the end Park's instinct and Seo's proof point the same way with neither able to close it.

predicaments.situation: the protector is the one doing the harm
predicaments.basis: the police torture innocents, destroy evidence at scenes, botch the stakeout on which a woman is killed, and Seo finally tries to shoot an unproved suspect.

predicaments.situation: a witness dies before he can speak
predicaments.basis: Baek turns out to have seen one of the murders, and is hit by a train while running from the detectives chasing him for what he knows.

relatives.title: Zodiac
relatives.shares: investigators who give their lives to a case that is never closed and a suspect who cannot be proved

relatives.title: The Secret in Their Eyes
relatives.shares: a killing that outlives the investigation and keeps hold of the men who worked it

relatives.title: In the Heat of the Night
relatives.shares: two lawmen with incompatible methods forced onto one case in a town that wants a quick culprit

relatives.title: Cure
relatives.shares: the discovery that the killer is unremarkable and indistinguishable from anyone on the street

relatives.title: Killers of the Flower Moon
relatives.shares: the people charged with protecting a community are the ones injuring it

films.title: Yeelen
films.engine: A magician learns that his son will be the death of him and sets out to kill him rather than let the boy grow into the power he keeps for himself; the son takes what he can carry from his father's things and runs, helped by his mother and then by a blinded uncle who once spent his sight on other people. The two meet at last with the same inherited weapons in their hands, and the collision kills both and burns the country to sand. What is left of it is picked up by a small boy who never met his father.

predicaments.situation: a father wants his child dead
predicaments.basis: Soma receives a vision that Nianankoro will cause his death and hunts him across the country with a tracking pylon, sacrificing an albino man and a dog for the power to do it.

predicaments.situation: a parent cannot bear the child surpassing them
predicaments.basis: when Nianankoro finally reaches him and tries to reason, Soma will not share the order's magic with his son on any terms and wants only his death.

predicaments.situation: one man hoards what should belong to all
predicaments.basis: Soma uses the Komo's magic for his own gain and warns the order that his son means to disperse it among all the people; the blind uncle Djigui is the one who already spent his sight using Kore's Wing for others.

predicaments.situation: a guest dishonours the one sheltering him
predicaments.basis: King Rouma Boli spares Nianankoro's life and takes him in, and Nianankoro sleeps with the king's wife Attou while treating her infertility.

predicaments.situation: a child reconstructs a parent from what remains
predicaments.basis: Nianankoro leaves his cloak with the pregnant Attou to give to his son, and the boy later crosses the new desert to take his father's egg from the place where both men died.

relatives.title: Ran
relatives.shares: a father and his children destroying one another over the power one of them will not release

relatives.title: The Empire Strikes Back
relatives.shares: a father and son holding the same inherited power, each of whom must undo the other

relatives.title: Big Fish
relatives.shares: a son assembling a father he never really had out of the objects and stories left behind

relatives.title: Killers of the Flower Moon
relatives.shares: an elder who will spend anyone, including his own blood, to keep what he holds

relatives.title: Autumn Sonata
relatives.shares: a parent who cannot let a child come into the thing the parent is

films.title: Killers of the Flower Moon
films.engine: A people made rich by oil under their own land are declared by law incompetent to handle their own money, and a white rancher who has spent years being everyone's friend turns that arrangement into a killing scheme: marry his nephew into one family, then remove the family one member at a time so the headrights land in the nephew's house. The nephew loves his wife and poisons her medicine every day on his uncle's instruction. When outside investigators finally arrive, the family is gone, the wife survives, and the sentences come to almost nothing.

predicaments.situation: a man harms the person he loves
predicaments.basis: Ernest Burkhart courts and marries Mollie Kyle, has three children with her, and doses her insulin with poison at Hale's direction until she nearly dies, refusing even at the end to admit it.

predicaments.situation: the protector is the one doing the harm
predicaments.basis: William King Hale is a reserve deputy sheriff and self-styled benefactor of the Osage, with the sheriff and judges in his pocket, while contracting the murders of the wealthy Osage he poses as friend to.

predicaments.situation: the owners are declared unfit to own
predicaments.basis: the law requires court-appointed white guardians over the money of full and half-blood Osage on the assumption they are incompetent, which is what makes the headrights worth killing for.

predicaments.situation: a guest dishonours the one sheltering him
predicaments.basis: Ernest is taken into Mollie's family and home by marriage and from inside it arranges the deaths of her sisters Anna and Reta, her first husband, and the bombing that leaves Mollie the last heir.

predicaments.situation: an elder directs a younger man to kill
predicaments.basis: Hale explains the arithmetic of inheritance to his nephews and orders Byron to kill Anna and Ernest to arrange Roan's murder and Reta's bombing.

predicaments.situation: a witness dies before he can speak
predicaments.basis: Hale murders his own hitmen to cover his tracks, an Osage representative on his way to lobby Congress is killed in Washington, and Mollie's private detective is beaten out of the case.

relatives.title: Gaslight
relatives.shares: a husband slowly deranging and poisoning the wife whose fortune he married into

relatives.title: Chinatown
relatives.shares: a benign-seeming patriarch enriching himself off a resource by destroying the family attached to it

relatives.title: The Godfather Part II
relatives.shares: an older man who has his own kin do the killing and loses the household he was building it for

relatives.title: The Act of Killing
relatives.shares: perpetrators who walk free and are absorbed back into the respectable life of the place

relatives.title: Memories of Murder
relatives.shares: the officers and officials of a place turning out to be the danger inside it

films.title: Aftersun
films.engine: An eleven-year-old goes on a cheap package holiday with the young father she now sees only occasionally, and spends two weeks half-noticing that he is coming apart behind a performance of being fine — he apologises, he buys the rug he can't afford, he cries alone after his birthday song. She is the one doing the comforting without knowing that is what she's doing. Twenty years later she plays the tapes she shot, trying to get near a man she was standing right beside.

predicaments.situation: one person hides their despair from another
predicaments.basis: Calum keeps his depression behind cheerfulness for Sophie, hides his smoking, reads self-help books alone, says he is surprised to have reached thirty, and sobs in the room after the birthday song.

predicaments.situation: a child takes care of the parent
predicaments.basis: when Sophie loses the expensive scuba mask she reads through her father's feigned nonchalance and comforts him, and she finds him asleep naked on the bed and covers him with a sheet.

predicaments.situation: a child reconstructs a parent from what remains
predicaments.basis: the adult Sophie, with her own wife and child and Calum's worn rug on the floor, watches the MiniDV footage of the holiday and dreams her way toward him through a strobing rave where he slips from her hands.

predicaments.situation: a farewell is not known to be final
predicaments.basis: the last night is a dance to "Under Pressure" and the morning is a wave at the airport gate; Calum packs the camcorder away and walks off down the corridor, and what Sophie has of him afterwards is the tape.

relatives.title: Big Fish
relatives.shares: a grown child assembling an unreachable parent out of the record he left

relatives.title: Tokyo Story
relatives.shares: understanding what a parent was only from the far side of losing them

relatives.title: Nobody Knows
relatives.shares: a child quietly managing an adult's failure without the vocabulary to name it

relatives.title: Still Walking
relatives.shares: an ordinary few days that turn out to be the whole of what a family gets

relatives.title: Manchester by the Sea
relatives.shares: a man performing normality over a despair he will not let the child beside him see

films.title: Autumn Sonata
films.engine: A daughter who has built a small careful life — a marriage without love, a disabled sister brought home from hospital, a drowned son — writes to the mother she has not seen for seven years and asks her to come. In one night she puts to her every charge she has been holding since childhood: the tours, the absences, the pushed abortion, the sister she believes was damaged by neglect. The mother defends herself, then breaks and asks forgiveness, then gets on a train and wonders aloud why the sister could not have died.

predicaments.situation: a child confronts a parent about the past
predicaments.basis: woken by Charlotte's nightmare, Eva spends the night accusing her mother of putting career and lovers ahead of her children, of emotional neglect, and of pressuring her into an abortion by the man she loved.

predicaments.situation: a parent cannot bear the child surpassing them
predicaments.basis: when Eva plays Chopin's Prelude No. 2 for her mother, Charlotte immediately sits down and plays it again, better, and explains why.

predicaments.situation: the one most in need is least wanted
predicaments.basis: Helena, paralysed and able to speak only in fragments Eva alone understands, drags herself from bed calling "Mama, come!", and on the train the next morning Charlotte asks why she couldn't die.

predicaments.situation: a parent outlives a young child
predicaments.basis: Eva's son Erik drowned just before his fourth birthday, and she visits his grave with suicidal thoughts on the morning after the confrontation.

predicaments.situation: an apology arrives too late to be received
predicaments.basis: Eva writes her mother a letter of apology which Viktor reads aloud and seals, and the film leaves it unclear whether it is ever sent or read.

predicaments.situation: a marriage endures without love
predicaments.basis: Eva respects Viktor but does not love him, and he stands listening at the door through the night's confrontation and chooses not to come in.

relatives.title: Ordinary People
relatives.shares: a mother who cannot love the surviving child, and a drowned son standing between them

relatives.title: The Piano Teacher
relatives.shares: a mother and daughter whose entire relation is conducted through music and control

relatives.title: Long Day's Journey into Night
relatives.shares: a family spending one night putting every old charge to one another aloud

relatives.title: Yeelen
relatives.shares: a parent who will not let a child come into the thing the parent is

relatives.title: Tokyo Story
relatives.shares: a visit after long separation that measures exactly how little is left between parent and child

films.title: Jules and Jim
films.engine: Two friends who would rather lose anything than lose each other meet a woman neither can hold, and instead of fighting over her they keep inventing arrangements — a marriage, a blessing, a house shared by three — that let all of them stay in the same room. Every arrangement holds until she tests it, and she keeps testing, because being handed from one man to the other is not the same as being chosen. The film is about how far two men will bend a friendship to keep a third person inside it.

predicaments.situation: two friends want the same person
predicaments.basis: Jules and Jim meet Catherine together, Jules marries her, and Jim never stops wanting her across twenty years, two countries and a war.

predicaments.situation: a man steps aside for his rival
predicaments.basis: Fearing Catherine will leave him for good, Jules gives Jim his blessing to marry her, on the condition that he may go on living near them.

predicaments.situation: one keeps proving no one owns them
predicaments.basis: Catherine takes affairs, once leaves Jules and their daughter for six months, misses the cafe meeting she asked for, and stages each departure so it will be felt.

predicaments.situation: a bond outlasts being put on opposing sides
predicaments.basis: Jules and Jim serve in opposing armies in the war, each spending it afraid he will meet the other or learn he has killed him.

predicaments.situation: a couple cannot make a child together
predicaments.basis: Jim and Catherine's failure to conceive breaks them apart; her pregnancy briefly promises a reunion, and her miscarriage cancels it.

predicaments.situation: a refusal is answered with death for both
predicaments.basis: When Jim rebuffs her and says he will marry Gilberte, Catherine asks Jules to watch, takes Jim into her car and drives it off a broken bridge.

relatives.title: Design for Living
relatives.shares: two friends agree to share the woman between them rather than lose each other

relatives.title: Y Tu Mamá También
relatives.shares: a woman becomes the medium through which two friends test what their bond really is

relatives.title: Double Suicide
relatives.shares: a love that cannot be lived in the world is completed by dying together

relatives.title: Le Bonheur
relatives.shares: a man tries to hold two loves at once without giving up either

relatives.title: The Dreamers
relatives.shares: three people build a private household whose rules only work while nobody outside looks in

films.title: Mother Joan of the Angels
films.engine: A priest is sent to a convent to drive the demons out of its prioress, after four priests failed and a fifth was burned for tempting the nuns. What grows between him and her cannot be sorted into possession or love, and he stops trying to sort it: he asks to take her demons into himself, and then murders two men in a stable because that is what he has come to believe love requires of him. The film is about a man who saves someone by agreeing to be damned in her place.

predicaments.situation: one is sent to succeed where others failed
predicaments.basis: Father Suryn arrives at the Smolensk convent after four exorcists have failed on Mother Joan and Father Garniec has been burnt at the stake.

predicaments.situation: love arrives where it is forbidden
predicaments.basis: Mother Joan tries to seduce Suryn and begs him to make her a saint; Sister Małgorzata falls for a squire who drinks at the inn.

predicaments.situation: a person must choose love or a calling
predicaments.basis: Suryn abandons the office he was sent to perform and receives Joan's demons through his love for her, and Małgorzata walks out of the convent as Margareth.

predicaments.situation: one takes another's affliction into himself
predicaments.basis: Rather than exorcise her a second time, Suryn asks for Joan's eight demons to pass into him, and they do.

predicaments.situation: one commits atrocity believing it saves another
predicaments.basis: Reasoning that only by doing Satan's bidding can he keep Joan free, Suryn takes an axe to the stablemen Kaziuk and Juraj and sends Margareth to tell Joan it was done for her.

predicaments.situation: one gives up shelter for a love
predicaments.basis: Małgorzata leaves the convent for the squire, who abandons her by the next morning, leaving her nothing to return to but Joan's silence.

relatives.title: The Devils
relatives.shares: an enclosed house of women, an accusation of possession, and a priest destroyed by what is wanted from him

relatives.title: Breaking the Waves
relatives.shares: someone commits an act the world calls monstrous in the conviction that it is what saves the beloved

relatives.title: Black Narcissus
relatives.shares: desire arrives inside a closed religious house and unmakes the person appointed to hold it together

relatives.title: Diary of a Country Priest
relatives.shares: a priest takes another's affliction into his own body and is consumed by the transfer

relatives.title: Winter Light
relatives.shares: a man in charge of others' souls is undone by a love he is not permitted to answer

films.title: Safety Last!
films.engine: A young man leaves his hometown promising to send for his girlfriend the moment he has made good, then fails to make good and spends his wages on gifts that say otherwise. When she arrives on the strength of those gifts, every hour he keeps the story standing costs more — an impersonation, a stunt, a friend who was supposed to do the dangerous part — until the only way to pay for it is to climb the outside of a twelve-storey building himself.

predicaments.situation: a person pretends to a success they lack
predicaments.basis: Harold, a struggling salesclerk sharing a rented room, sends Mildred expensive presents he cannot afford so she will think he is prospering in the city.

predicaments.situation: someone is taken for what they are not
predicaments.basis: Mildred arrives believing he can support a family, and he has to pass himself off as the store's general manager, even using the role to get back at the floorwalker Stubbs.

predicaments.situation: a promise made at parting must be earned
predicaments.basis: He can only send for Mildred once he has "made good", which turns the whole city stay into a debt he must clear before she may come.

predicaments.situation: the promised help never arrives
predicaments.basis: Bill, who was to take over the climb after the first floor, is chased away by the policeman on every landing, promising each time to meet Harold one storey higher.

relatives.title: I Was Born, But…
relatives.shares: a man's real standing is exposed to the people he most wanted to keep impressed

relatives.title: The Apartment
relatives.shares: someone borrows a position he does not hold in order to keep a courtship alive

relatives.title: Hero
relatives.shares: the dangerous deed and the credit for it end up attached to different people by accident

relatives.title: The Cameraman
relatives.shares: an unqualified man improvises his way through a job to hold on to a woman who believes in him

films.title: The Red Shoes
films.engine: A young dancer is taken up by a man who runs his company on the rule that anyone who loves a person cannot give everything to the work, and then falls in love with the composer he himself hired. Each man in turn orders her to give up the other; she is the only one in the arrangement asked to give anything up, and the two demands finally meet on the same night in two different cities. The film is about what happens to a person who is loved by two people as a possession and never asked what she wants.

predicaments.situation: one demands another give up all other loves
predicaments.basis: Boris Lermontov dismisses his principal dancer for marrying, and later gives Julian the choice of leaving Vicky or leaving the company.

predicaments.situation: love arrives where it is forbidden
predicaments.basis: Vicky and Julian fall in love while working together on The Ballet of the Red Shoes, inside a company whose head treats attachment as theft from the art.

predicaments.situation: a person must choose love or a calling
predicaments.basis: On the night of Julian's opera and her own comeback, Vicky is made to decide between her husband's ultimatum and staying with the ballet, and chooses to stay.

predicaments.situation: one gives up shelter for a love
predicaments.basis: Vicky leaves Lermontov's company to marry Julian in London, where his opera advances and her dancing career stalls into nothing.

predicaments.situation: a calling consumes the one it chose
predicaments.basis: The ballet Vicky dances is about shoes that will not let their wearer stop until she dies, and she runs from the theatre in them into the path of a train.

relatives.title: Black Swan
relatives.shares: a director's possession of a dancer and a role that eats the person performing it

relatives.title: Whiplash
relatives.shares: a mentor requires that everything outside the work be given up, and calls that love of the art

relatives.title: Pakeezah
relatives.shares: a performer is pulled apart between a man who wants her and a life on the stage that will not release her

relatives.title: All That Jazz
relatives.shares: the work is served past the point where the body can keep serving it

relatives.title: Letter from an Unknown Woman
relatives.shares: a woman is the only party to a bond who is ever asked to surrender anything

films.title: The Man Who Shot Liberty Valance
films.engine: A lawyer walks into a frontier town insisting an outlaw can be answered with courts and schoolbooks, is beaten for it, and finally faces the man with a gun — and is publicly credited with a killing that the local rancher actually did, unseen, from an alley. The rancher keeps quiet, loses the woman on the same night, and hands over both the town's future and his own place in it; the lawyer builds a career on the credit and is buried in it. The film is told at the rancher's funeral, by the man who owes him everything.

predicaments.situation: a deed is credited to the wrong person
predicaments.basis: The whole territory believes Ranse Stoddard shot Liberty Valance; Tom Doniphon fired from the shadows with Pompey's rifle at the same instant and tells only Ranse.

predicaments.situation: a duel is decided by a hidden hand
predicaments.basis: Ranse, drunk-wounded and outmatched, appears to win the street fight only because a rifleman none of the onlookers can see fires at the same moment.

predicaments.situation: two friends want the same person
predicaments.basis: Tom has been renovating a house for his intended marriage to Hallie while Ranse, whom he keeps rescuing, is the man she nurses and eventually marries.

predicaments.situation: a man steps aside for his rival
predicaments.basis: Tom burns the house he built for Hallie, then walks into the convention to tell Ranse to take the nomination "for Hallie's sake", and leaves without speaking again.

predicaments.situation: a truth is suppressed to protect a life
predicaments.basis: Having finally heard the real story, the newspaper editor burns his reporter's notes rather than publish it, saying that when the legend becomes fact you print the legend.

relatives.title: Cyrano de Bergerac
relatives.shares: one man supplies what wins the woman and another is thanked for it, by his own arrangement

relatives.title: Casablanca
relatives.shares: a man delivers the woman he loves to the man whose future is worth more than his own

relatives.title: The Leopard
relatives.shares: someone who belongs to the ending order quietly hands the world over to the man who will replace him

relatives.title: Hero
relatives.shares: a public story attaches to the wrong man and nobody with the truth is willing to break it

relatives.title: Rashomon
relatives.shares: the account that survives a killing is chosen for what it lets people live with, not for what happened

films.title: Gladiator
films.engine: A dying emperor tells his general that his own son is unfit and asks the general to take the succession instead; the son hears it, kills his father, and then has the general's wife and child killed. Sold into the arena as a slave, the general finds the one place his enemy is obliged to stand in front of him — and the one currency the emperor cannot simply seize, which is the crowd's affection for whoever is bleeding in the sand.

predicaments.situation: a father prefers a stranger to his son
predicaments.basis: Marcus Aurelius names Maximus regent to restore the Republic and tells Commodus he is unfit to rule; Commodus embraces him and murders him.

predicaments.situation: one lives on to avenge a murdered family
predicaments.basis: Maximus escapes execution, reaches his farm too late to find his wife and son alive, buries them, and tells Commodus in the Colosseum exactly what he intends.

predicaments.situation: a crowd's favour is the only protection left
predicaments.basis: Proximo tells Maximus to win the crowd to win his freedom, and Commodus, though he holds every other power, will not have him killed for fear of making a martyr.

predicaments.situation: a duel is decided by a hidden hand
predicaments.basis: Commodus has Maximus stabbed in the ribs before their final match and conceals a knife in his sleeve for when the sword fails him.

predicaments.situation: the promised help never arrives
predicaments.basis: The escape to the loyal legions at Ostia collapses — Proximo and his gladiators die covering the flight, Cicero is killed at the rendezvous, and Maximus is taken there alone.

predicaments.situation: a child is used to control a parent
predicaments.basis: When young Lucius lets slip what he has overheard, Commodus threatens the boy in front of Lucilla to force her out of the conspiracy and into giving him an heir.

relatives.title: Ran
relatives.shares: a ruler's decision about who follows him tears the family apart and kills him first

relatives.title: Spartacus
relatives.shares: a slave's standing with the people who watch him fight becomes the only political power available to him

relatives.title: The Count of Monte Cristo
relatives.shares: a man stripped of family and name returns under another identity to reach the person who took them

relatives.title: Baahubali: The Beginning
relatives.shares: the succession passes over the blood son, and the wronged heir has to be answered in an arena the usurper controls

relatives.title: Hamlet
relatives.shares: a father is murdered by the kinsman who wanted his place, and the survivor's whole life narrows to that one debt

films.title: Seemabaddha
films.engine: A salesman on the edge of promotion finds the goods already ruined and quietly arranges violence in his own workplace so that the delay belongs to nobody. He gets the promotion and the congratulations, and in the same movement loses the regard of the young woman staying in his house who had believed he was better than that — and his own. The film is about the exact price paid, by strangers, for one man's step up.

predicaments.situation: many are harmed to serve one man's aim
predicaments.basis: Shyamal and the labour officer provoke a false riot and lock-out at the fan factory, a watchman is badly injured, and the workers' stoppage is used to cover the repainting of the defective export consignment.

roles.harmed: the injured watchman and the locked-out workforce

predicaments.situation: a disturbance is staged to excuse a failure
predicaments.basis: A contract clause permits late delivery in case of civil disturbance, so the disturbance is manufactured to cover the flaw in the painted fans.

predicaments.situation: an admirer sees what the admired man does
predicaments.basis: Tutul, daughter of Shyamal's old teacher, arrives admiring his idealism and by the end of the crisis has watched him engineer it.

predicaments.situation: a guest envies the life she is shown
predicaments.basis: Tutul is toured through the restaurants, clubs, parlours and race courses of her sister's married life and is secretly envious of that marriage.

relatives.title: The Apartment
relatives.shares: advancement bought by a compliance that costs the regard of the one person who thought better of him

relatives.title: Sweet Smell of Success
relatives.shares: a man's climb watched with growing disgust by someone close enough to have believed in him

relatives.title: Michael Clayton
relatives.shares: a firm's disaster made to look like something else, by a man rewarded for handling it

relatives.title: A Hero
relatives.shares: a standing built on a small manipulation collapsing in the eyes of those who looked up to him

relatives.title: Il Posto
relatives.shares: a young man absorbed by a company whose comforts arrive as a kind of loss

films.title: The Cat o' Nine Tails
films.engine: A man who has learned something disqualifying about his own body breaks in to destroy the record of it, and then kills, one after another, everyone who might connect him to that break-in. Against him are a working reporter and a blind former reporter who can no longer see anything but notices what nobody else does; when the killer runs out of witnesses he takes the blind man's niece instead, and the chase stops being professional.

predicaments.situation: a man kills to keep a secret buried
predicaments.basis: Casoni broke into the Terzi Institute only to swap the record showing he tested positive for the XYY chromosome the Institute was linking to criminal tendency, and kills repeatedly to keep that swap unknown.

predicaments.situation: a man is killed for what he knows
predicaments.basis: Calabresi says he knows who broke in and why, tries to blackmail the intruder and is pushed under a train; the photographer and Bianca are strangled for holding the picture and the note.

predicaments.situation: a blind man depends on another's eyes
predicaments.basis: Franco cannot see the cropped photograph or Bianca's locket, but his niece Lori describes what she watches Bianca do with it, and the case turns on that description.

predicaments.situation: a loved one is taken to stop pursuit
predicaments.basis: Casoni kidnaps Lori and offers her life in exchange for Franco and Carlo dropping the investigation; they judge he will kill her regardless and call the police.

predicaments.situation: a lie about a death provokes a killing
predicaments.basis: Cornered, Casoni tells Franco that Lori is already dead; Franco throws him down the elevator shaft as the living Lori calls out.

relatives.title: Blow-Up
relatives.shares: an uncropped photograph as the only thing that knows what happened

relatives.title: Rear Window
relatives.shares: an investigator who cannot move about it himself and must borrow other people's eyes

relatives.title: Wait Until Dark
relatives.shares: a blind person made the target of someone hunting a hidden object

relatives.title: Memories of Murder
relatives.shares: leads pursued one by one while the killer stays a step ahead of each

relatives.title: Les Diaboliques
relatives.shares: killings committed to protect one concealed fact rather than out of appetite

films.title: Memories
films.engine: Three stories about people swallowed by something that keeps running after its reason is gone. A dead singer's station offers salvage men their lost loves back and will not let them leave; a sick technician carries a poison he cannot smell obediently toward the capital, killing whole cities on the way because that is what he was told to do; and a boy in a walled city watches his father load shells at an enemy no one has ever seen, and falls asleep wanting to be the man who gives the order.

predicaments.situation: a spurned lover kills the one refusing her
predicaments.basis: Eva Friedel murdered her fellow singer Carlo Rambaldi for refusing to marry her, and afterwards vanished into the station she built around the memory.

predicaments.situation: someone stands in for one long gone
predicaments.basis: Eva's hologram forces Miguel into Carlo's likeness until he answers to the name, and conjures Heintz's dead daughter Emily to keep him on the station.

predicaments.situation: a man destroys everything without knowing he does
predicaments.basis: Nobuo Tanaka swallows an experimental pill for flu medicine and walks toward Tokyo emitting a gas that kills every animal for miles, including all 200,000 people of Kōfu, believing throughout that he is delivering the drug as instructed.

predicaments.situation: many are harmed to serve one man's aim
predicaments.basis: Headquarters orders the contaminated Tanaka to carry the drug to Tokyo, and the country empties behind him; at the end a soldier is put in the suit's place so the delivery is completed and the room dies.

predicaments.situation: a child is told he will understand later
predicaments.basis: The boy asks his father why they are fighting at all, and is told he will understand when he is older; he then falls asleep imagining himself as the officer who fires the great gun.

predicaments.situation: the ones ordering stay clear of the danger
predicaments.basis: The father, a cannon-loader, is blamed for a mishap and made to stand beside the railway gun without gear while the lavishly dressed officer fires it.

relatives.title: Solaris
relatives.shares: a lost love returned as a copy that will not let the living man leave

relatives.title: Vertigo
relatives.shares: a person pressed into standing in for someone dead

relatives.title: Paths of Glory
relatives.shares: those who give the order kept at a safe distance from what it costs

relatives.title: Come and See
relatives.shares: a boy inside a war whose purpose no adult will explain to him

relatives.title: Dr. Strangelove
relatives.shares: a catastrophe carried forward by obedient men and no longer callable back

films.title: One Hundred and One Nights
films.engine: A film student is paid to spend her evenings talking cinema with a very old man whose memory is dissolving into the movies he made, and who mistakes himself and everyone around him for other people. She and her boyfriend decide to install a fake version of his long-vanished great-grandson in the house so his fortune can pay for a short film. The impostor grows genuinely fond of the old man, and a woman the old man takes for someone else walks off with everything.

predicaments.situation: the young scheme to inherit from the old
predicaments.basis: Camille and Mica plan to reach Simon Cinéma's fortune through a planted heir so the money can fund Mica's short film.

predicaments.situation: someone stands in for one long gone
predicaments.basis: A young man also named Vincent is coached with childhood details and presented as the great-grandson unseen for ten years, convincing both the groundskeeper and the delighted old man.

predicaments.situation: an impostor comes to love the one deceived
predicaments.basis: Vincent, planted to take a third of the inheritance, is pleased rather than sorry when the fortune is lost, having grown fond of Cinéma.

predicaments.situation: a man mistakes those before him for others
predicaments.basis: Cinéma takes a begging vagabond for a princess and a knight, his visitors for figures out of his films, and the entertainer Marina for Elizabeth Taylor.

predicaments.situation: schemers are outdone by a better schemer
predicaments.basis: Marina, taken for Elizabeth Taylor at the garden party, has the old man sign his entire fortune over to her before the three plotters can act.

relatives.title: Sunset Boulevard
relatives.shares: a young hire kept in the house of an old figure of the movies who lives inside a delusion

relatives.title: Six Degrees of Separation
relatives.shares: a stranger passed off as family who becomes something real to the household

relatives.title: The Return of Martin Guerre
relatives.shares: an impostor installed as the missing heir and accepted by those who should know

relatives.title: Kagemusha
relatives.shares: a substitute standing in for a man who is gone, and growing into the part

relatives.title: The Music Room
relatives.shares: an old man alone in a large house living off the world he used to preside over

films.title: Lucky Luciano
films.engine: A man who reached the top of his trade by clearing away the men above him is let out of prison because the state finds a use for him, and rebuilds the same operation abroad through men who take the risks for him. The agent sent to bring him down is stopped less by the boss than by his own superiors, who tell him to drop it; the friend who agreed to inform is killed before he can say anything under oath.

predicaments.situation: a criminal is freed in exchange for service
predicaments.basis: Luciano offers himself to military intelligence during the war, receives a commutation from Governor Dewey and is deported to Italy, where he immediately takes over the drug trade.

predicaments.situation: a man is killed for what he knows
predicaments.basis: Giannini, turned informant and sent back to testify against Luciano, is assassinated on Luciano's orders before he can appear.

predicaments.situation: a pursuer is called off from above
predicaments.basis: Siragusa's superiors order him to halt the investigation; he accuses them of protecting Dewey over the commutation and they deny it.

predicaments.situation: a man rises by removing those above him
predicaments.basis: Salvatore Lucania becomes boss of all bosses in the 1930s by eliminating his rivals for power.

predicaments.situation: a woman carries word between two men
predicaments.basis: Giannini writes to Siragusa through his mistress, who has begun an affair with Luciano and lets him read the letters that expose the double-dealing.

relatives.title: Serpico
relatives.shares: an investigator obstructed by the institution that sent him

relatives.title: Z
relatives.shares: an inquiry closed down from above once it reaches the people who matter

relatives.title: The Godfather Part II
relatives.shares: a criminal organisation and the state trading favours until neither can prosecute the other

relatives.title: Infernal Affairs
relatives.shares: an informant killed before he can give the evidence he was placed to give

relatives.title: Gomorrah
relatives.shares: a trade run through proxies so the man at the centre is never in the room

films.title: The Salt of the Earth
films.engine: An economist driven out of his country picks up the camera his wife bought and spends decades standing in front of famine, war and mass flight, until the second visit to Rwanda takes his belief in people away and he no longer knows what the pictures are for. The same wife then proposes replanting his father's exhausted land, and the man who had photographed the end of things starts photographing what is still intact.

predicaments.situation: a partner turns a life onto another course
predicaments.basis: Lélia buys the camera that ends Sebastião's career as an economist, supports his move to full-time photography in 1973, and later has the idea of reforesting the family land that becomes Instituto Terra.

predicaments.situation: a witness is unmade by what he sees
predicaments.basis: After the Sahel famine, the Yugoslav wars and a return visit to the Rwandan refugees a year on, Salgado lost hope for humanity and questioned the point of his own work.

predicaments.situation: an exile makes a life far from home
predicaments.basis: Salgado left Brazil for political reasons in the late 1960s and built his career in France, homesick and unable to return, photographing other parts of the Americas instead.

predicaments.situation: a son comes home to his father's failure
predicaments.basis: Sebastião and Lélia leave Paris for his native Minas Gerais to run his ailing father's ranch, and turn the depleted land into a reforestation project.

relatives.title: The Killing Fields
relatives.shares: a witness worn through by the scale of what he is present for

relatives.title: Waltz with Bashir
relatives.shares: a man trying to work out what looking at atrocity did to him

relatives.title: Sans Soleil
relatives.shares: an image-maker asking what his own images are finally for

relatives.title: The Man Who Planted Trees
relatives.shares: exhausted land brought back by one couple's decades of planting

relatives.title: Nostalgia for the Light
relatives.shares: turning a life spent on human catastrophe toward the older, non-human world

films.title: A Serious Man
films.engine: A settled family man watches his life come apart in every direction at once — his wife wants a religious divorce so she can marry a family friend, someone is writing anonymous letters against his tenure, a student's father has him cornered over an envelope of cash — and his entire response is to keep asking, of anyone who might know, what he did to deserve any of it. The film is the sequence of people he asks and the nothing they give back. It ends with him committing his first real wrong act and the bill for it arriving in the same minute.

predicaments.situation: the blameless are punished without any cause
predicaments.basis: Larry is moved out of his own house into a motel, emptied of his bank accounts, and threatened at work, insisting throughout that he has not done anything.

roles.afflicting: Judith, Sy Ableman, the anonymous letter-writer, Clive's father

predicaments.situation: answers are demanded from those with none
predicaments.basis: Larry consults three rabbis in turn and receives advice about changing his perspective, an unfinished anecdote about Hebrew letters found on a patient's teeth, and a closed door.

predicaments.situation: a gift is a trap for its receiver
predicaments.basis: Clive Park leaves an envelope of cash in Larry's office and Clive's father promises to sue him either for defamation if he reports it or for the money if he does not pass the boy.

predicaments.situation: the displaced man honours the one replacing him
predicaments.basis: Judith installs Larry in a motel so she can marry Sy Ableman, and after Sy dies in a car crash Larry is the one who pays for the funeral.

predicaments.situation: one is made responsible for a failing relative
predicaments.basis: Larry's brother Arthur sleeps on the couch filling a notebook with his probability map of the universe, then faces gambling and solicitation charges whose lawyer's bill lands on Larry.

relatives.title: Winter Light
relatives.shares: a man brings unbearable questions to a religious authority and finds the authority emptier than he is

relatives.title: The Trial (1962)
relatives.shares: penalties accumulate against a man through a process nobody will explain to him

relatives.title: Ordet
relatives.shares: a household's disaster is handed over to faith, which answers on terms nobody asked for

relatives.title: Ikiru
relatives.shares: a medical verdict arrives and retroactively reframes everything the man has been busy with

films.title: The Elephant Man
films.engine: A severely deformed man kept hooded and beaten as a fairground exhibit is bought for an afternoon by a surgeon who wants to examine him, and turns out to be literate, gentle and entirely aware of how he is being handled. The doctor takes him in permanently, and the rescue converts him into a different sort of exhibit — for medical colleagues, then for fashionable visitors, then for drinkers a porter smuggles in at night. What the film turns on is the man's own insistence, against everyone busy deciding what he is, that he is a man.

predicaments.situation: a person becomes something strangers come to see
predicaments.basis: John Merrick is displayed for coins by Bytes, presented unclothed to the medical society by Treves, received by society ladies as a curiosity, and sold to late-night gawkers by the porter Jim.

predicaments.situation: the speechless are explained by those around them
predicaments.basis: Bytes presents Merrick as an unspeaking imbecile and keeps him hooded, until Treves coaxes him into talking and finds he reads and has the 23rd Psalm by heart.

predicaments.situation: the rescuer repeats what he rescued from
predicaments.basis: Treves buys Merrick out of the freak show and then exhibits him to colleagues and drawing-room guests, and Mrs Mothershead's objection makes him question whether he differs from Bytes.

predicaments.situation: a life is owned by the one profiting
predicaments.basis: Bytes treats Merrick as his property, beats him nearly to death for being taken away, and later kidnaps him back to work the circuits until he collapses in Belgium.

predicaments.situation: a stranger's presence is taken for a threat
predicaments.basis: Boys chase Merrick through Liverpool Street station and a crowd unmasks and corners him after he knocks a small girl down.

relatives.title: The Enigma of Kaspar Hauser
relatives.shares: a person kept as a spectacle is taken up by benefactors who study and improve him while still exhibiting him

relatives.title: Freaks
relatives.shares: people whose bodies are their livelihood are looked at by an audience that will not grant them personhood

relatives.title: Frankenstein (1931)
relatives.shares: a being taken for a monster is cornered by a mob that has never spoken to him

relatives.title: Devi
relatives.shares: a person is installed somewhere strangers travel to come and look at them

films.title: Eureka
films.engine: Three people survive a bus hijacking — the driver and two schoolchildren — and none of them can pick ordinary life back up: the children stop speaking and are left alone when their mother walks out and their father dies, and the driver loses his marriage and his ability to drive. He moves into the children's house and keeps it, cooking and making them eat, while a detective keeps returning to him about women being killed nearby. The boy who will not speak turns out to be the one doing it, and the man who took him in is the one who has to walk him to the police.

predicaments.situation: survivors of one harm cannot resume ordinary life
predicaments.basis: Naoki and Kozue stop going to school and stop speaking, and Makoto cannot go back to driving a bus and takes to the road.

predicaments.situation: a household is dismantled by events outside it
predicaments.basis: After the hijacking the Tamura mother abandons the family, the father dies in a crash that may be suicide, and Makoto returns home to find his wife gone.

predicaments.situation: an outsider becomes the parent of orphaned children
predicaments.basis: Makoto moves into the Tamura house with no claim on it, takes over the housekeeping and sees that Naoki and Kozue eat properly.

predicaments.situation: the speechless are explained by those around them
predicaments.basis: Naoki says nothing at all, and his sister, his cousin Akihiko, the detective and Makoto each read their own meaning into the silence.

predicaments.situation: the helper is suspected of the harm
predicaments.basis: The detective who handled the hijacking harasses Makoto about a neighbourhood murder without evidence, and arrests him when a second woman, a friend of his, is killed.

predicaments.situation: a guardian must deliver his charge to punishment
predicaments.basis: Once it becomes clear Naoki is the killer, Makoto confronts him on the converted bus and persuades him to give himself up.

relatives.title: The Sweet Hereafter
relatives.shares: a bus catastrophe leaves a driver and a town unable to resume, with the survivors' silence at the centre

relatives.title: Nobody Knows
relatives.shares: children abandoned by their parents keep a household running with no adult entitled to be there

relatives.title: Three Colours: Blue
relatives.shares: the survivor of a crash refuses to re-enter ordinary life and has to be coaxed back into it

relatives.title: Ordinary People
relatives.shares: a family that has come through the same violence cannot speak about it and comes apart along the silence

relatives.title: Manchester by the Sea
relatives.shares: a man wrecked by an event takes charge of a bereaved adolescent and keeps house for him

films.title: A City of Sadness
films.engine: From the day the Japanese leave Taiwan to the years after the Kuomintang crackdown, one Keelung family's four brothers are consumed one at a time by whoever happens to hold power — smugglers, mainland gangs, then the state itself — for reasons that have almost nothing to do with them. The deaf youngest son and the nurse he marries keep a household going through it and quietly fund her brother's mountain resistance until it is wiped out. The film ends with a woman writing letters asking whether anyone has heard anything about her husband.

predicaments.situation: a household is dismantled by events outside it
predicaments.basis: Wen-liang comes back shellshocked and is tortured into brain damage, Wen-hsiung is killed in a gambling-house fight, and Wen-ching is taken away by the government, all inside a few years of the Lin family opening a nightclub.

roles.dismantling: the Shanghai gang, the Nationalist state

predicaments.situation: the blameless are punished without any cause
