predicaments.basis: The Shanghai gang uses mainland connections to have the Lin brothers denounced as Japanese collaborators, and Wen-ching is later arrested and disappeared while summary trials and executions go on around him.

predicaments.situation: a hidden guest is hunted by the state
predicaments.basis: Hinoe is sent away from his parents' ancestral home to hide, marries and joins an anti-Kuomintang group in the mountains, and is executed with almost all of them.

predicaments.situation: the speechless are explained by those around them
predicaments.basis: Wen-ching is deaf, and the people around him — Hinomi, his brother Wen-hsiung scolding him for not proposing, Hinoe telling him that Hinomi loves him — carry his side of things for him.

predicaments.situation: those left behind must ask after the missing
predicaments.basis: Hinomi writes to Ah-shue that she has searched around Taipei for news of Wen-ching and cannot find any.

relatives.title: Ashes and Diamonds
relatives.shares: the hour a war formally ends is the hour a new round of political killing begins on the same streets

relatives.title: Nostalgia for the Light
relatives.shares: the people left over from a crackdown spend their lives asking anyone at all for news of the disappeared

relatives.title: The Official Story
relatives.shares: a state's disappearances turn out to run straight through the middle of one household

relatives.title: Ugetsu
relatives.shares: a family is scattered and eaten by a war and by the brothers' ventures inside it

relatives.title: Katyń
relatives.shares: relatives keep writing and searching for men the state has already killed and will not admit to

films.title: Devi
films.engine: A young wife who keeps her father-in-law's house, helps him at his prayers, and mothers her small nephew is woken one night by the old man falling at her feet: he has dreamt that she is the goddess. The household installs her in a private room as an idol, a sick child appears to recover from the water washed off her feet, and supplicants start arriving from far away. Her husband comes back from his studies to take her out of it and discovers she half believes it herself, and will not go.

predicaments.situation: a person becomes something strangers come to see
predicaments.basis: Doyamoyee is moved into a separate part of the mansion, seated as an idol with rituals performed around her, and worshipped by a growing crowd of supplicants who travel from afar.

predicaments.situation: one comes to believe what others call her
predicaments.basis: At the riverbank Doyamoyee begins to wonder whether she really is a goddess, and by the end she is putting on her wedding clothes saying they must leave before she is killed.

predicaments.situation: an offered escape is refused by the captive
predicaments.basis: Umaprasad sneaks into her room at night and gets her as far as a waiting boat, and she panics and asks to be taken home.

predicaments.situation: a sick child is entrusted to faith alone
predicaments.basis: Kalikinkar overrides the doctor Harasundari had called and has the feverish Khoka given the water from Doyamoyee's feet and left in her arms overnight; the boy is dead by morning.

predicaments.situation: a father cannot be argued out of belief
predicaments.basis: Umaprasad confronts Kalikinkar over the dream and the staged worship, and the old man's brief doubt disappears the moment the beggar's grandson opens his eyes.

relatives.title: Ordet
relatives.shares: a rural household organises itself around one member's claim on the divine and a body is left waiting on it

relatives.title: Rosemary's Baby
relatives.shares: a young wife is enclosed by a household that has decided what she is, while her husband is elsewhere

relatives.title: Breaking the Waves
relatives.shares: a woman is read by those around her as an instrument of God and is destroyed by living up to it

relatives.title: The Passion of Joan of Arc
relatives.shares: men in authority interrogate a young woman about what she is until the answer stops being hers

relatives.title: The Elephant Man
relatives.shares: a person is installed where strangers come to look at them and cannot get back out of the role

films.title: The Iron Giant
films.engine: A boy finds an enormous crashed machine in the woods that eats metal and knows nothing about itself, and takes on teaching it the difference between a hero and a weapon. A government agent who treats anything unidentified as an enemy moves into the boy's house to find out what he is hiding, and escalates until a nuclear missile is aimed at the town by mistake. The machine settles the argument about what it is by flying up to meet the missile.

predicaments.situation: a stranger's presence is taken for a threat
predicaments.basis: Kent Mansley reads the crashed giant as a foreign weapon on sight and brings General Rogard and the Army down on Rockwell.

predicaments.situation: one made for harm refuses to do harm
predicaments.basis: The Giant's weapon systems fire on reflex when Hogarth points a water gun at him, he flees in shame, and Hogarth pulls him out of full battle mode by reminding him he can choose who to be.

predicaments.situation: a hidden guest is hunted by the state
predicaments.basis: Hogarth and Dean keep the Giant fed in the scrapyard and pass him off as a sculpture while Mansley rents a room in Hogarth's house to watch him.

predicaments.situation: the helper is suspected of the harm
predicaments.basis: The Giant catches two boys falling from a building and wins the townspeople over for a moment, and Mansley immediately urges Rogard to open fire on him.

predicaments.situation: the feared one dies for those fearing him
predicaments.basis: With the missile Mansley launched falling back on Rockwell, the Giant says goodbye to Hogarth and flies up to collide with it above the atmosphere.

relatives.title: E.T. the Extra-Terrestrial
relatives.shares: a child hides a non-human friend in his house from adults who want it as a specimen

relatives.title: Frankenstein (1931)
relatives.shares: a made being learns what it is by being feared and hunted, and by one moment of harm it did not intend

relatives.title: The Day the Earth Stood Still
relatives.shares: a visitor's peaceful arrival is answered with gunfire because no one will find out what it wants first

relatives.title: Edward Scissorhands
relatives.shares: a gentle made thing with dangerous hands is taken in by a household and then turned on by the town

relatives.title: The Elephant Man
relatives.shares: a crowd's fear of an unfamiliar body forces the one they fear to insist on what he actually is

films.title: Tár
films.engine: A conductor with absolute say over who plays, who is promoted and who is dropped has been using that say to pull young women close and to shut them out again, and has kept an assistant to handle the wreckage. The film is the stretch in which the wreckage stops being handled: a former protégée's death, a viral clip and a set of saved emails strip her of the orchestra, her daughter and the constructed name, until she is back in the house she came from as the person she was born as.

predicaments.situation: intimacy is taken from those under one's power
predicaments.basis: Lydia rigs a blind audition and programs a concerto to install the young cellist Olga as soloist, having previously mentored and then blacklisted Krista, and lies to her wife about how she was hurt following Olga home.

predicaments.situation: a plea for help is not taken seriously
predicaments.basis: Krista sends disturbing emails to Francesca and is answered with a deletion order and a lawyer; she then takes her own life and her parents sue.

predicaments.situation: the keeper of secrets becomes the accuser
predicaments.basis: Francesca, told to destroy the correspondence and then denied the assistant conductor post, resigns, renames the ghostwritten memoir draft Rat on Rat, and supplies the incriminating emails to the deposition.

predicaments.situation: a place is given for reasons besides merit
predicaments.basis: Lydia alters her scorecard behind the blind audition screen for Olga and plans to hand Francesca the assistant conductor post over Sebastian, who names the favouritism to her face.

predicaments.situation: a parent is kept from their child
predicaments.basis: Sharon, furious at the allegations and at being kept in the dark, bars Lydia from seeing Petra, the daughter for whom Lydia was writing a piece she never finishes.

predicaments.situation: a made self is stripped to its origin
predicaments.basis: Removed from the podium and told to stay out of sight, Lydia returns to the Staten Island house, finds childhood certificates in the name Linda Tarr, and is told by her brother that she has forgotten where she came from.

relatives.title: Whiplash
relatives.shares: a mentor's favour is dispensed and withdrawn over someone young enough to be shaped by it

relatives.title: The Assistant
relatives.shares: the subordinate who tidies up after a powerful figure becomes the one holding the record of what happened

relatives.title: All About Eve
relatives.shares: proximity to a great career is used as a route into it, and the patron pays

relatives.title: The Blue Angel
relatives.shares: a figure of unquestioned authority is undone by desire and ends stripped of every title

relatives.title: The Hunt
relatives.shares: a crowd turns on one person all at once on the strength of an account nobody tests

films.title: Intolerable Cruelty
films.engine: A divorce lawyer who has built a career on sending spouses away with nothing meets a woman who marries in order to come away with everything, and each sets out to strip the other. What keeps happening is that the document designed to make love impossible to profit from keeps getting torn up, by both of them, as the only way either can say anything sincere.

predicaments.situation: a spouse is found out with someone else
predicaments.basis: Donaly walks in on his wife Bonnie with an ex-boyfriend, and a private investigator films Rex Rexroth at a motel with a blonde for Rex's wife Marylin.

predicaments.situation: marriage is entered for what it pays
predicaments.basis: Marylin has a concierge point her to a rich, foolish philanderer she can easily divorce, and later stages an entire fake oil-millionaire husband to strip Miles.

predicaments.situation: the keeper of secrets becomes the accuser
predicaments.basis: Puffy Krauss von Espy, the concierge Marylin used to find her mark, is put on the stand by Miles and testifies to exactly what she asked him for, and she leaves the court with nothing.

predicaments.situation: a safeguard is destroyed to prove devotion
predicaments.basis: Howard eats the Massey pre-nup at the wedding, Marylin tears up the one Miles signs in Las Vegas, and Miles retroactively signs another at the divorce table which she tears up too.

predicaments.situation: the wronged one strikes back in kind
predicaments.basis: Beaten in court, Marylin recruits the ruined Donaly to supply a fake husband and takes Miles's fortune; Miles's firm answers by hiring a hitman, whom Marylin then pays double to kill Miles instead.

predicaments.situation: two adversaries are drawn to each other
predicaments.basis: Miles takes the opposing party to dinner out of boredom and fascination, and the case they are fighting turns into a marriage neither can litigate their way out of.

relatives.title: The Awful Truth
relatives.shares: a couple keep fighting each other with the machinery of divorce because it is the only way left to court

relatives.title: Trouble in Paradise
relatives.shares: two people whose trade is taking from others fall for the one person they cannot safely rob

relatives.title: Divorce Italian Style
relatives.shares: a marriage is treated as an asset to be disposed of by whatever legal instrument is at hand

relatives.title: The Lady Eve
relatives.shares: a con run on a mark curdles into real feeling, and the con has to be confessed to be survived

relatives.title: Gone Girl
relatives.shares: spouses fight with staged evidence and paperwork, each holding the document that would destroy the other

films.title: Honey Don't!
films.engine: A woman who investigates for a living gets a frightened phone call from a stranger who is dead before their meeting, and pulling on that death finds a church that takes girls in and keeps them. While she works it, her teenage niece drifts toward the same vanishing point, and the policewoman she has taken to bed turns out to be the person doing the vanishing.

predicaments.situation: a plea for help is not taken seriously
predicaments.basis: Mia phones Honey because she is too afraid to go to the police and is stabbed before the meeting; later Marty refuses to believe Honey heard a gunshot at the church and will not search it.

predicaments.situation: intimacy is taken from those under one's power
predicaments.basis: Reverend Drew Devlin preaches submission as one of his Four Ways and holds "fellowship" in bed with young women of his congregation while running narcotics behind the temple.

predicaments.situation: a lover turns out to be the danger
predicaments.basis: MG, the policewoman Honey sleeps with and turns to for help, is holding Corinne captive in her basement and killed Mia; she stabs Honey, who kills her with a kettle and a gun.

predicaments.situation: a secret is kept from a parent
predicaments.basis: Honey agrees not to tell her sister Heidi that Corinne was assaulted by her boyfriend, on condition Corinne drop him, and MG agrees not to file a report.

predicaments.situation: an absent parent asks to be let back
predicaments.basis: The old man Corinne fled at the bus stop is Honey and Heidi's estranged father, who approaches Honey wanting to reconnect and hands her the last sighting of her niece.

predicaments.situation: two adversaries are drawn to each other
predicaments.basis: Honey and Chère, the trafficking liaison who stripped the temple ring from Mia's body and shot the reverend, catch each other's eye at a stoplight and flirt.

relatives.title: Chinatown
relatives.shares: an investigator following a death arrives at a man who has been taking the young of his own community

relatives.title: The Night of the Hunter
relatives.shares: a preacher's authority over the devout is the cover for what he does to them

relatives.title: Memories of Murder
relatives.shares: women keep dying while the people paid to listen treat every warning as not worth acting on

relatives.title: Les Diaboliques
relatives.shares: the person sharing the bed is running the killing the protagonist is trying to solve

relatives.title: Cure
relatives.shares: the danger is domestic and near at hand rather than out in the world being hunted

films.title: La Chinoise
films.engine: Five young people spend a summer in an apartment lent by one of their wealthy parents, reading and lecturing each other until they have talked themselves into the position that a person may be killed to close a university. The talk then meets the world: the one who argues for a milder line is thrown out, the most unstable one shoots himself, and the one who goes out to do the killing transposes two digits and has to kill twice.

predicaments.situation: a doubter is expelled by his own group
predicaments.basis: Henri argues the pro-Soviet line against the cell's willingness to use violence, is denounced as a revisionist, and is put out of the apartment.

predicaments.situation: the household work falls to one of them
predicaments.basis: Yvonne, the peasant girl who sometimes sells sex for money, does the chores and is kept apart from the lectures except when performing skits in them.

predicaments.situation: one lives off what one claims to oppose
predicaments.basis: The cell studies the destruction of bourgeois institutions from a lavish borrowed flat belonging to a member's rich parents, who reclaim it at the end by tearing the posters down and clearing the shelves.

predicaments.situation: someone will not be talked out of it
predicaments.basis: On the train to the killing, the philosopher Francis Jeanson argues at length that violence will not achieve what she wants; Véronique goes on to the hotel anyway.

predicaments.situation: a killing falls on the wrong person
predicaments.basis: Véronique reverses the digits of the room number and shoots a stranger, then goes back and kills the intended target once she realises the error.

predicaments.situation: one of them takes their own life
predicaments.basis: Kirilov, the nihilist painter, covers the apartment walls in rainbows and shoots himself while the others carry on with the programme.

relatives.title: United Red Army
relatives.shares: a small cell turns its theory inward and starts trying its own members for insufficient purity

relatives.title: Zabriskie Point
relatives.shares: students theorise a violent act and the act, when it comes, lands nowhere near the theory

relatives.title: The Terrorist
relatives.shares: a young woman is sent out to kill for a cause and the argument against it never quite reaches her

relatives.title: The Baader Meinhof Complex
relatives.shares: children of comfortable families arm themselves against the class that is paying for the room

relatives.title: Night and Fog in Japan
relatives.shares: a leftist group's meeting becomes a tribunal over one member's deviation

films.title: Something to Talk About
films.engine: A woman catches her husband kissing another woman and, going to her family for backing, finds that her father did the same to her mother for years and that nobody in the family considers it worth stopping the season for. Pulling that thread opens up what she gave up to be there at all — a training abandoned when she got pregnant, a job she never wanted in her father's business — so that saving the marriage and going back to school become the same decision.

predicaments.situation: a spouse is found out with someone else
predicaments.basis: Grace sees Eddie kiss a blonde outside the bank and then catches them at the restaurant he claimed was a client dinner; her research later turns up her father Wyly's affairs, and Georgia throws him out.

predicaments.situation: a plea for help is not taken seriously
predicaments.basis: Grace goes to her father for support over the marriage and gets nothing back but the upcoming show jumping competition and which horse will run in it.

predicaments.situation: a child learns the parent did the same
predicaments.basis: Grace digs into her father's past and finds he cheated on her mother with several women, which turns her private trouble into the family's standing arrangement.

predicaments.situation: the wronged one strikes back in kind
predicaments.basis: Grace nearly sleeps with the trainer Jamie and does lightly poison Eddie with her grandmother's recipe, which sends him to a divorce attorney.

predicaments.situation: a life was set aside for the family
predicaments.basis: Grace dropped out of veterinary school when she became pregnant with Caroline and went to work in her father's barn, and the depression that followed is why she stopped sleeping with Eddie.

relatives.title: An Unmarried Woman
relatives.shares: a wife discovers the affair and has to work out what of her own she abandoned to be a wife

relatives.title: Scenes from a Marriage
relatives.shares: a marriage is taken apart in conversation until both parties can say what they actually stopped giving

relatives.title: Fire
relatives.shares: a household's daughters find that the men's arrangements have been standing for a generation and are expected to stand

relatives.title: The Awful Truth
relatives.shares: a couple circle a divorce and find that neither has stopped wanting the other

films.title: No End
films.engine: A month after her husband dies of a heart attack at the wheel, a woman tries every available substitute for him — a stranger who pays her, a hypnotist who offers to erase him, his old files and photographs — and none of them takes. Meanwhile his unfinished case goes on without him: the man he was defending has chosen to stay in prison on hunger strike and has to be talked back into accepting release, and the arrangement that frees him is exactly the one his lawyer's widow cannot make for herself.

predicaments.situation: the dead will not let go
predicaments.basis: Antek narrates his own death and keeps appearing to Ula, who takes a hypnotist's offer to be made to forget him and sees him during the session instead.

predicaments.situation: a man refuses the release offered to him
predicaments.basis: Darek, arrested for organising for Solidarity, insists on his hunger strike and on staying imprisoned even after Labrador arranges union testimony that would cut his sentence; an apprentice lawyer finally talks him out of it and the sentence is suspended.

predicaments.situation: a stranger is used to fill an absence
predicaments.basis: Ula scoffs at the young Englishman's offer of fifty dollars in the bar and then agrees, one of several attempts — the files, the photographs, the hypnotist — to get her husband back by proxy.

predicaments.situation: one of them takes their own life
predicaments.basis: Ula leaves Jacek at her mother-in-law's, tapes her mouth shut in front of the gas oven, and is next seen walking beside Antek on a lawn, both in black.

predicaments.situation: a child is left behind by a parent
predicaments.basis: Jacek, who has nightmares about his parents and is comforted by Ula after one of them, is dropped off at his grandmother's before she kills herself.

relatives.title: Three Colours: Blue
relatives.shares: a widow methodically tries to erase a husband and finds he is not the sort of thing that can be erased

relatives.title: Ugetsu
relatives.shares: the dead go on keeping house with the living, who would rather that than the alternative

relatives.title: Hunger
relatives.shares: a prisoner refuses the release on offer because taking it would concede what he is starving to assert

relatives.title: Truly, Madly, Deeply
relatives.shares: a bereaved woman's husband stays present in the room and every substitute is measured against him

relatives.title: Don't Look Now
relatives.shares: grief keeps producing appearances of the lost person until the survivor follows one

films.title: Flesh for Frankenstein
films.engine: A man who wants to father a whole obedient people rather than live with the family he already has takes the bodies of the local young apart and reassembles them to his own specification, including their appetites. Everyone in his house treats another person as a thing to be used — he uses corpses, his wife uses the servant she summons, his assistant copies him — and each of them dies at the hands of the thing they used. The one flicker of a person left inside the made man is his memory of a friend, and it is that, not any rescue, that ends the household.

predicaments.situation: a maker is destroyed by his own making
predicaments.basis: The Baron assembles a male creature from corpse parts and commands it to kill Nicholas; the remnants of the dead friend's personality rebel and the creature kills the Baron instead.

predicaments.situation: a person is used purely for another's appetite
predicaments.basis: The Baron satisfies himself through the female creature's surgical wounds, Otto imitates him and disembowels her, and Katrin is given the male creature for her own use and is killed in the act.

predicaments.situation: a lover is handed over for a reward
predicaments.basis: Katrin, having taken Nicholas as her lover to satisfy appetites her husband-brother ignores, betrays him to the Baron after they fall out and is paid in the use of the male creature.

predicaments.situation: a friend returns without knowing anyone
predicaments.basis: Nicholas sees his would-be-monk friend's face on the creature serving dinner and pretends not to recognise it; the creature shows no sign of knowing him until the moment it refuses to kill him.

predicaments.situation: the young inherit their elders' cruelty
predicaments.basis: After every adult in the castle is dead, the Baron's children Erik and Monica raise Nicholas on the laboratory crane and take up the scalpels themselves.

relatives.title: Eyes Without a Face
relatives.shares: a man cuts up other people's bodies to build the person he wants and is destroyed by his own handiwork

relatives.title: The Skin I Live In
relatives.shares: a person is surgically remade to a private specification and eventually turns on the maker

relatives.title: Ju Dou
relatives.shares: a neglected wife takes a lover inside a tyrant's household, and the child of the house grows up lethal

relatives.title: Island of Lost Souls
relatives.shares: creatures assembled by a man to obey him kill him when he orders one killing too many

relatives.title: Bride of Frankenstein
relatives.shares: a made man's stubborn scrap of memory and feeling defeats the plan he was built for

films.title: A Taxi Driver
films.engine: A broke single father steals another driver's fare — take a foreigner to a city and back for a day's big money — and drives into a place where the army is shooting its own citizens. He runs once, gets as far as the road home, hears the lie being told about what he left behind, and turns around; from then on the paid errand is something he is doing on purpose, and other men die keeping his car moving. When it is over he gives the foreigner a false name and a wrong number, so that the gratitude can never reach him.

predicaments.situation: a paid errand becomes a binding obligation
predicaments.basis: Kim Man-seob takes the 100,000 won Gwangju fare purely for the money, and the students and local drivers refuse to let Peter pay him until the agreed trip is actually completed.

predicaments.situation: kin is weighed against strangers in danger
predicaments.basis: Unable to reach his young daughter in Seoul, Man-seob drives out of Gwangju with fake plates, then turns back to the hospital where Jae-sik lies dead and refuses to leave Peter's side.

predicaments.situation: a deserter returns to the one he left
predicaments.basis: Man-seob abandons Peter with the students and drives off, and comes back after hearing the radio in Suncheon blame the killings on North Korean infiltrators.

predicaments.situation: an outsider is needed to witness what happened
predicaments.basis: Peter, a German journalist smuggled in as a businessman, films the crackdown while the broadcasters say infiltrators caused it; Jae-sik's last shouted words are to get the footage out to the world.

predicaments.situation: strangers give their lives for a passing stranger
predicaments.basis: At the roadblock chase, the Gwangju taxi drivers put their cars between the pursuing agents and Man-seob's taxi and are killed so that he and the footage get through.

predicaments.situation: a rescuer refuses to be thanked
predicaments.basis: Man-seob writes "Kim Sa-bok" and a cigarette company's number in Peter's notebook, and reads about Peter's award decades later without ever answering the public search for him.

relatives.title: The Killing Fields
relatives.shares: a foreign reporter can only carry out what he saw because a local man stayed with him past any obligation

relatives.title: Under Fire
relatives.shares: an outsider with a camera is the only route by which a massacre becomes known

relatives.title: Le Havre
relatives.shares: a poor man takes on a stranger's danger as his own and is covered by his neighbours

relatives.title: Salvador
relatives.shares: a mercenary errand in a country being shot up turns into something the man does on purpose

relatives.title: Hotel Rwanda
relatives.shares: an ordinary man ferrying people to safety while the official story denies the killing

films.title: Trois places pour le 26
films.engine: A famous man comes home to stage a musical of his own life and starts looking, off-hours, for the first love he lost. He finds her, and separately takes up with a young admirer he has pulled out of a shop and into the show; over breakfast she works out that his stories about his old lover are stories about her mother. The film ends by folding the thing it has just discovered — that he slept with his daughter — into a family reunion, all three boarding the train together.

predicaments.situation: lovers discover they are parent and child
predicaments.basis: Yves and Marion spend the night together after the opening, and she recognises her own mother in his account of his lost love; he learns it when she arrives with Mylène.

predicaments.situation: a first love is found again decades later
predicaments.basis: Yves searches Marseille for Mylène, and a card left at his hotel by a baroness turns out to be her; he recognises her voice on the telephone and they meet in the bar where they first met.

predicaments.situation: a child grows up not knowing her father
predicaments.basis: Mylène bore her daughter after she and Yves parted and raised her alone; Marion works in a perfume shop and knows him only as the star she wants tickets to see.

predicaments.situation: an outsider steps into a place suddenly vacant
predicaments.basis: When the leading lady leaves the cast because she is pregnant, Marion — trained but working behind a counter — volunteers and is hired into the role opposite him.

relatives.title: Edipo Re
relatives.shares: two people discover, after the fact, that they are parent and child

relatives.title: Chinatown
relatives.shares: a parentage kept hidden for years comes out as the thing everything else was standing on

relatives.title: Secrets & Lies
relatives.shares: a woman finds the mother who gave her up and the family is rearranged around the reunion

relatives.title: Sansho the Bailiff
relatives.shares: a search across many years for the family member lost at the start, ending in a meeting

relatives.title: All About Eve
relatives.shares: a devoted admirer is let into the star's professional and private life and takes a vacated place

films.title: Hangmen Also Die!
films.engine: A man kills the occupier's governor in the street and cannot be found, so the occupiers seize four hundred townsmen and start shooting them forty at a time until someone gives him up. The woman who misdirected the soldiers on impulse now has her own father among the hostages, and has to decide whether her father's life is worth the assassin's. What the city does instead is agree, in enormous numbers and without ever saying so, to tell one lie together and hang the killing on a man who deserves it — and the hostages are shot anyway.

predicaments.situation: many are held to force one to surrender
predicaments.basis: After Heydrich's assassination the Nazis take four hundred Czech men hostage and execute them in batches of forty until the killer gives himself up or is denounced.

predicaments.situation: kin is weighed against strangers in danger
predicaments.basis: With Professor Novotny among the hostages, Mascha demands Svoboda surrender, then goes to the Gestapo to denounce him and finds herself pleading for her father instead.

predicaments.situation: a whole community lies with one voice
predicaments.basis: Mascha stages a scene to get herself and Czaka taken in and names him as the man fleeing the assassination, and a great many people come forward to swear to a story they know is false.

predicaments.situation: the trusted insider is the informer
predicaments.basis: Emil Czaka sits in on resistance meetings and knows its leaders while working for the Germans; when the members trick him into showing himself, most of them are killed or arrested.

predicaments.situation: a promised release is never granted
predicaments.basis: Gruber offers Professor Novotny's freedom for information and Mascha is later told the surviving hostages will be let go; the Gestapo shoot all of them, her father included.

predicaments.situation: closeness is faked to mislead a watcher
predicaments.basis: Staged conversations between Mascha and Svoboda persuade Gruber they are lovers and that her fiancé Jan is being cheated on, which keeps the investigation pointed away from the assassination.

relatives.title: The Battle of Algiers
relatives.shares: an occupied population collectively shields a wanted man while the occupier takes the whole neighbourhood as leverage

relatives.title: Army of Shadows
relatives.shares: a resistance cell discovers the informer among its own and has to deal with him itself

relatives.title: Rome, Open City
relatives.shares: neighbours hide a hunted man and hand over their own lives rather than the name

relatives.title: Come and See
relatives.shares: a whole village is destroyed as reprisal for what the partisans did

relatives.title: The Wind That Shakes the Barley
relatives.shares: the price of one killing is paid by people who did not do it, and by the one who informs

films.title: Like Father, Like Son
films.engine: A man who has measured everything, including his son, by achievement is told that the boy he has raised for six years is not his by blood and that his blood son is growing up in a poorer, warmer household. The film is what happens when he treats this as a problem to be solved efficiently, and then discovers that the child he was ready to hand back had spent those years quietly watching and loving him.

predicaments.situation: a child is given to another family
predicaments.basis: After months of meetings the Nonomiyas and the Saikis agree to permanently exchange Keita and Ryūsei, the boys switched at birth.

predicaments.situation: a parent must choose between two children
predicaments.basis: Ryōta and Midori must decide between the son they raised and the son who is biologically theirs, and Ryōta first tries to evade it by offering to buy both boys from the Saikis.

predicaments.situation: harm was done deliberately by an unsuspected hand
predicaments.basis: In court a nurse admits she switched the newborns out of envy at the Nonomiyas' happiness while she struggled with her own stepchildren, and the statute of limitations has run out.

predicaments.situation: the wronged one confronts the person responsible
predicaments.basis: Ryōta goes to the nurse's apartment to return her apology money and berate her for wrecking his family, and her stepson steps in to defend her.

predicaments.situation: a child chooses the family that raised them
predicaments.basis: Ryūsei runs away from the Nonomiya house back to the Saikis, and Keita runs from Ryōta when the Nonomiyas visit.

roles.left: the parents claiming them by blood

predicaments.situation: a parent learns too late he was loved
predicaments.basis: Going through his camera, Ryōta finds a run of photographs Keita secretly took of him, mostly asleep, and breaks down.

relatives.title: The Kid
relatives.shares: a man who raised a child not his own is required to give him up to the rightful claim

relatives.title: Sophie's Choice
relatives.shares: a parent is put in the position of choosing between two children

relatives.title: Secrets & Lies
relatives.shares: a blood claim arrives from outside and unsettles a family that had already been made

relatives.title: The Return
relatives.shares: a father tries to build a bond with a son on a schedule of his own devising and cannot

relatives.title: Rabbit-Proof Fence
relatives.shares: children removed from the household that raised them make their own way back to it

films.title: Last Tango in Paris
films.engine: A man whose wife has just killed herself takes a young stranger to an empty apartment on one condition: they will never learn each other's names or histories. He enforces that condition with a violence that at one point becomes rape, and when it stops serving him and he wants to be known and loved by name, she uses the rule he wrote to dispose of him — he is a stranger who assaulted her, and nothing else.

predicaments.situation: intimacy is allowed only without names
predicaments.basis: Paul insists that he and Jeanne exchange no personal information at all, not even given names, in the apartment they both came to rent.

predicaments.situation: a lover forces himself on the other
predicaments.basis: Paul anally rapes Jeanne in the apartment, using butter as lubricant, and she stays on afterwards saying she cannot make herself leave.

predicaments.situation: one is left by a death without explanation
predicaments.basis: Paul is mourning his wife Rosa's suicide, and only tells Jeanne about it after he has already broken off and resumed the affair.

predicaments.situation: a lover leaves without a word
predicaments.basis: Paul packs up and vacates the apartment, and Jeanne arrives to find him and everything of his gone.

predicaments.situation: someone forces their way into another's home
predicaments.basis: Paul chases Jeanne through the streets past her threats to call the police and pushes his way into the apartment she shares with her mother.

predicaments.situation: the hunted turns and strikes the hunter
predicaments.basis: Cornered in her own flat, Jeanne takes a gun from a drawer, finally tells Paul her name, and shoots him.

relatives.title: In the Realm of the Senses
relatives.shares: a sealed erotic arrangement that shuts out every other fact of the participants' lives and ends in killing

relatives.title: Vertigo
relatives.shares: a man in mourning imposes terms of identity on a woman and pursues her past refusal

relatives.title: Une liaison pornographique
relatives.shares: two strangers meet for sex under an explicit rule that nothing personal be exchanged

relatives.title: Fatal Attraction
relatives.shares: one party refuses to accept that an anonymous affair is over and forces their way back into the other's home

relatives.title: Repulsion
relatives.shares: a young woman corners a man in her own flat and kills him

films.title: Black Rain
films.engine: A young woman is caught in the fallout that falls on the city after the bomb, and years later every family considering her as a bride withdraws the moment they hear where she was that morning. The film is about the uncle and aunt who took her in trying to arrange an ordinary life for someone everyone else has quietly written off, while the illness they are all waiting for takes their neighbours one at a time.

predicaments.situation: a person is shunned for what befell them
predicaments.basis: Every family approached about marrying Yasuko withdraws its proposal on learning she was in Hiroshima on the day of the bombing, fearing sickness or unhealthy children.

predicaments.situation: people wait for an illness already inside them
predicaments.basis: Shigematsu watches his fellow survivors die of radiation sickness one after another while his own, his wife's and Yasuko's health quietly declines.

predicaments.situation: a child chooses the family that raised them
predicaments.basis: Yasuko turns down her remarried father's offer of a place in his house and stays with the uncle and aunt who brought her up.

predicaments.situation: permission to marry is withheld then granted
predicaments.basis: Shigematsu is indignant when Yuichi's mother asks his approval for the match, because of Yuichi's war trauma, but later consents.

predicaments.situation: two damaged people find each other
predicaments.basis: Yasuko, marked by the black rain and unmarriageable, grows close to Yuichi, a neighbour disabled by what the war did to his mind.

relatives.title: Philadelphia
relatives.shares: a person is dropped by everyone around them once the nature of their illness is known

relatives.title: Ikiru
relatives.shares: a life is arranged around an illness already inside the body and the time it leaves

relatives.title: Safe
relatives.shares: the healthy keep their distance from someone whose sickness they cannot see but fear

relatives.title: An Autumn Afternoon
relatives.shares: an older relative negotiates a marriage for a young woman in his household and hesitates over the match

relatives.title: Grave of the Fireflies
relatives.shares: children left by the bombing depend on relatives whose willingness to keep them is finite

films.title: Women of the Night
films.engine: Three women left without men or money in a bombed-out city are each pushed into selling sex, and the same man ruins two of them in turn — taking the sister of the woman he first kept, and leaving both infected. What the film turns on is that everyone who then lectures them about decency has no answer to the question of how they are supposed to eat, and that the only person who reaches one of them is another woman who has been where she is.

predicaments.situation: a child dies for want of care
predicaments.basis: Fusako sells her belongings for food and cannot afford her infant's vaccinations, which her brother-in-law refuses to pay for; the baby dies of illness, and later Natsuko's untreated syphilis kills her child in the womb.

predicaments.situation: a man takes the sister of his lover
predicaments.basis: Kuriyama, who made the widowed Fusako his mistress and his opium courier, begins sleeping with her repatriated sister Natsuko, whom he meets at a dance hall.

predicaments.situation: the wronged one confronts the person responsible
predicaments.basis: Released from the prison hospital, pregnant and infected, Natsuko has it out with Kuriyama, who shrugs off what he did to Fusako and orders her to abort.

predicaments.situation: one wronged sets out to harm all others
predicaments.basis: Fusako declares she will avenge herself on the men of Japan by passing syphilis to them, and cannot answer when a clinician asks whether it has worked.

predicaments.situation: the comfortable lecture the desperate about virtue
predicaments.basis: A purity-association representative visits the prison hospital and is met by prostitutes asking how they are meant to be fed if they stop.

roles.lecturing: the purity association and the clinicians

predicaments.situation: one draws the danger onto herself for another
predicaments.basis: Fusako talks Kumiko out of the trade in the ruined church and is savagely beaten by the rival prostitutes' leader for it until the others pull her off.

predicaments.situation: a group turns on one of its own
predicaments.basis: The women working the district beat Fusako for renouncing prostitution in front of them, then order her and Kumiko never to come back.

relatives.title: Sisters of the Gion
relatives.shares: two sisters take opposite positions toward the men who keep them and both are discarded

relatives.title: Nights of Cabiria
relatives.shares: a woman selling sex is stripped of everything by the man she trusted and has to decide whether to go on

relatives.title: Vivre sa vie
relatives.shares: a woman with no money and no support drifts into prostitution and is owned by the men around it

relatives.title: Mother India
relatives.shares: a woman without a husband weighs degradation against her children starving

relatives.title: Rosetta
relatives.shares: someone with no options is told to behave decently by people who will not feed her

films.title: Panic Room
films.engine: A newly divorced woman and her diabetic daughter, one night into a house they barely know, shut themselves into a room built to keep intruders out — and find that what the child needs to stay alive is outside the door while what the three men came for is inside it. Everything after that is a negotiation over which side of a steel door each person ends up on, decided finally by the one intruder who will not let a child be hurt.

predicaments.situation: someone forces their way into another's home
predicaments.basis: Junior, Burnham and Raoul break into the brownstone on Meg and Sarah's first night, for bearer bonds in a safe inside the panic room.

predicaments.situation: one draws the danger onto herself for another
predicaments.basis: Meg leaves the panic room to fetch Sarah's glucagon during her seizure, and later takes on Raoul with a sledgehammer so Sarah is not carried off as a hostage.

predicaments.situation: rescuers are turned away by the endangered
predicaments.basis: With Sarah in the intruders' hands, Meg persuades the two officers responding to Stephen's 911 call and the neighbours' complaints that nothing is wrong.

predicaments.situation: accomplices turn on each other over the spoils
predicaments.basis: Junior lets slip that the safe holds far more than he told the others and is shot by Raoul when he tries to quit, and Burnham is then forced to continue.

predicaments.situation: one of the attackers protects the ones attacked
predicaments.basis: Burnham gives Sarah her medication, and turns back at her screams to shoot Raoul before he can bring the sledgehammer down on Meg.

predicaments.situation: the hunted turns and strikes the hunter
predicaments.basis: Meg baits the men into an ambush on the stairs and knocks Raoul over the banister with a sledgehammer.

relatives.title: Wait Until Dark
relatives.shares: a woman alone in her own home outmanoeuvres intruders who came for something hidden in it

relatives.title: The Desperate Hours
relatives.shares: a family is held prisoner inside its own house by men who cannot leave without what they came for

relatives.title: Cujo
relatives.shares: a mother trapped in a confined space with a child whose medical need is just out of reach

relatives.title: Aliens
relatives.shares: a woman puts herself between a child and what is hunting them both

relatives.title: The Treasure of the Sierra Madre
relatives.shares: partners in a theft turn on each other once the size of the prize is known

films.title: Stalag 17
films.engine: A barracks of prisoners loses two men in an escape and concludes there is an informer among them, then settles on the one man who openly trades with the guards and profits from everyone else's boredom and misery. The film is the price the group extracts from him before it emerges that the informer is the man they appointed to keep them safe — and that the man they beat is the only one who can get the marked prisoner out.

predicaments.situation: a group turns on one of its own
predicaments.basis: The men of Barracks 4 conclude Sefton sold out the radio and Dunbar, and beat him brutally in the barracks.

predicaments.situation: one profits from the misery of the rest
predicaments.basis: Sefton runs rat races, a distillery and a telescope for gambling and drink, and bribes the guards for a day with the Russian women, which is what makes him look bought.

predicaments.situation: harm was done deliberately by an unsuspected hand
predicaments.basis: Manfredi and Johnson were shot escaping and Dunbar was arrested as a saboteur because someone in the barracks was passing messages to the Germans through a hollowed chess piece.

predicaments.situation: the one trusted most has been betraying them
predicaments.basis: Price, the barracks' own security officer, is caught by Sefton speaking German with Schulz and demonstrating the matchbook bomb as evidence against Dunbar, and is thrown out into the searchlights with cans on his leg.

predicaments.situation: the one they wronged does what they cannot
predicaments.basis: After being beaten as the suspected informer and guarded by the real one, Sefton is the man who goes down into the water tower and takes Dunbar out through the wire.

relatives.title: The Thing
relatives.shares: a sealed group hunts the traitor among them and turns on the wrong man first

relatives.title: Le Corbeau
relatives.shares: a closed community tears itself apart trying to identify an informer in its own ranks

relatives.title: The Ox-Bow Incident
relatives.shares: a group convinces itself of a suspect's guilt and punishes him on nothing but suspicion

relatives.title: Army of Shadows
relatives.shares: an underground group must find and dispose of the informer inside it

relatives.title: The Departed
relatives.shares: the man placed in charge of protecting the group is the one selling it out
